We show empirically and analytically that these models are naturally more aligned with left-to-right decoding than MDMs. Based on this observation, we propose Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD), a simple training-free sampling method that preserves left-to-right unmasking structure while allowing parallel token commitment. Extensive experiments show that PARD consistently outperforms existing parallel samplers in generation quality, while achieving substantial speedups over pure AR decoding with only a small quality gap.

</details>


### [251] [CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24312)
*Mingxuan Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CONSISTRE框架，通过推理时约束感知提示+验证+自我反思（黑盒LLM）和训练时知识蒸馏+GRPO对齐（开源小模型）两种方式，提升文档级关系抽取的一致性，减少矛盾预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在DocRE中对每个候选三元组独立预测，违反传递性、对称性、功能唯一性等关系约束，导致输出矛盾不可靠。

Method: 双轨框架：(1) 推理时：约束感知提示 + 约束验证 + 迭代自我反思；(2) 训练时：教师蒸馏推理轨迹→学生SFT + GRPO对齐（联合优化抽取性能与关系一致性）。

Result: DocRED上两种方案均优于基线；推理时方案使用现成黑盒LLM即达竞争性F1；训练时方案使7-8B开源模型大幅缩小与专有LLM的差距，且推理成本低。

Conclusion: 显式建模一致性可有效缓解关系矛盾，提升LLM-based DocRE在不同部署范式下的可靠性。

Abstract: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.

</details>


### [252] [Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24332)
*Phuong Le Huy,Nam H. Nguyen,Quan V. Dang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出交叉注意力校准去重（CACD）方法，用于改进RAG系统中的冗余分块问题。CACD使用交叉编码器保留token级细节，结合新信息分数（NIS）和多候选投票机制，在SQuAD 1.1数据集上平均移除9.75%的冗余块，速度比最强基线快约27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统的分块策略常产生冗余块，导致向量数据库膨胀和检索变慢。基于余弦相似度的去重方法将每个块压缩为单一向量，丢失了能够区分真正重复与仅主题相似的token级细节信息。

Method: CACD包含三个部分：(1) 使用交叉编码器进行逐token比较，而非单向量池化比较；(2) 新信息分数（NIS），基于交叉编码器的注意力熵计算，衡量新块中未被已有候选块解释的部分；(3) 多候选多数投票机制，替代单一最佳匹配策略。

Result: 在SQuAD 1.1数据集上，CACD平均移除9.75%的冗余块，与语义级方法相当；平均处理时间51.0秒，比最强基线NERExact（69.6秒）快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤（356.7秒）快约7倍。

Conclusion: CACD在检测冗余块时保持了token级精度，同时速度显著优于现有方法。但结果仅基于单一数据集，属于初步比较，尚不能推广为一般性结论。

Abstract: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.

</details>


### [253] [Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models as Components of Cognitive Computing architecture for Regulatory Knowledge Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24352)
*Dariusz Nowak-Nova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文验证了将大语言模型（LLM）与检索增强生成（RAG）架构相结合，能够在无需高端GPU的本地部署环境中，将LLM从独立的生成模型转变为具有更高认知可靠性的计算基础设施组件，显著提升生成文本的事实一致性、领域规范性和规范性精度，并支持法规管理中的可审计性和动态知识更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证LLM与RAG架构集成后，能否从独立的生成模型转变为具有增强认知可靠性的计算基础设施组件，以支持需要持续分析和解释法律法规的监管管理流程。

Method: 提出一种混合认知架构：本地部署LLM（Bielik和PLLuM模型，运行于Ollama和LM Studio环境，使用消费级硬件，无需高端GPU）作为语义解释模块，RAG层作为受控知识检索、上下文关联和信息源可追溯模块，两者协同工作。

Result: 1) RAG增强显著提升了生成文本的事实一致性、领域规范性和规范性精度；2) 降低了无据生成内容的风险；3) 引入了可审计性、受控知识管理和动态法规信息更新能力，无需重新训练语言模型。

Conclusion: 本地部署的LLM加上RAG不应仅被视为文本生成工具，而应被视为认知计算基础设施中的语义处理模块，适用于高法律和信息波动性环境下的法规合规与组织决策支持。

Abstract: The aim of this article is to verify whether integrating large language models (LLMs) with the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture enables their transformation from standalone generative models into components of cognitive computing infrastructure with enhanced epistemic reliability. The study proposes an architectural approach based on locally deployed LLMs operating in on-premises environments without high-end GPU accelerators and examines their applicability in supporting regulatory management processes requiring continuous analysis and interpretation of legal acts. The proposed solution combines local LLMs with external knowledge repositories, creating a hybrid cognitive architecture in which the language model performs semantic interpretation while the RAG layer provides controlled knowledge retrieval, contextualization, and traceability of information sources. The implementation was validated using the Ollama and LM Studio execution environments together with the Polish language models Bielik and PLLuM running on consumer-class hardware. The results demonstrate that augmenting LLMs with RAG significantly improves the factual consistency, domain specificity and normative precision of generated texts while reducing the risk of unsupported content generation. Furthermore, the study shows that integrating RAG introduces auditability, controlled knowledge management and dynamic updating of regulatory information without retraining the language model. The findings indicate that locally deployed LLMs enhanced with RAG should be regarded not merely as text generation tools but as semantic processing modules within cognitive computing infrastructures supporting regulatory compliance and organizational decision-making in environments characterized by high legal and informational volatility.

</details>


### [254] [Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24368)
*Ruizhe Li,Mingxuan Du,Benfeng Xu,Zhendong Mao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现长期记忆系统依赖“记忆与查询相似”的假设，但世界知识会打破这一假设（如坚果过敏影响马卡龙查询）。作者构建了InMind基准（125个任务，涵盖10个生活领域），通过对比实验揭示：尽管记忆系统能100%回忆事实，但在间接查询中最高仅14.4%的准确率，问题出在查询驱动的检索接口本身，而非存储或知识缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统基于“所需记忆与查询相似”的隐性假设，但世界知识（如坚果过敏与马卡龙的关系）使得文本间无表面相似性，导致检索失败。现有评估混淆了“信息未存储”、“模型缺乏知识”和“信息存储但未检索到”三种情况，无法定位问题根源。

Method: 构建InMind基准：包含125个任务（113个基于可引用公开来源），覆盖10个生活领域，配对的对照组设计分离三种失败模式。测试6种向量、图及代理记忆系统，并引入诊断性探测（在查询前保持记忆可见）来定位问题。

Result: 有记忆置于上下文时，骨干模型回答间接查询准确率达84.0%；而需检索时，六种记忆系统最高仅14.4%（尽管直接回忆准确率达100%）。更高维度的嵌入略微提升目标召回率但未缩小差距。让记忆在查询前可见可恢复大部分差距。

Conclusion: 问题出在查询条件化的检索接口本身，而非存储或知识。核心挑战是路由（routing）——决定哪些事实必须保持可见。InMind旨在为这一开放问题提供评分基准。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.

</details>


### [255] [Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24371)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 三种开源LLM（Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma2 9B）在医疗模式下存在显著的schema不合规问题（基线合规率85.9-91.6%），但通过闭环验证-修复框架可将合规率提升至99.0%，证明该方法是实现医疗互操作性的有效系统级保障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型具备临床推理能力，但集成到电子健康记录系统时面临关键障碍——生成的结构化输出不符合医疗标准schema（如ICD-10、CPT、HL7 FHIR），阻碍了医疗互操作性的实现。

Method: 在320个临床场景（覆盖10个医学专科）中本地部署三种开源模型，共960个模型-场景对。采用基线条件与验证-修复条件对比评估，通过精确McNemar检验分析统计显著性。

Result: 1) 三个模型家族不合规率一致（85.9-91.6%），表明问题源于医疗训练语料共性缺陷而非模型特异性；2) 96%的检测失败属于表示层格式违规（如替代医学术语缩写、代码前缀错误），模型遵循临床书写惯例但缺乏医疗IT标准意识；3) 验证-修复框架实现99.0%总体合规率（98.4-99.4%），多数错误在1-2次迭代内解决，p<0.001统计显著。

Conclusion: 闭环验证-修复是有效的系统级保障措施，可显著提升医疗schema合规性，为下游临床系统集成做好准备。

Abstract: Healthcare interoperability requires AI systems to produce structured outputs conforming to standardized schemas including ICD-10 for diagnostic coding, CPT for procedure billing, and HL7 FHIR for data exchange. While large language models demonstrate clinical reasoning capabilities, their integration into electronic health record systems faces a critical barrier: schema noncompliance. We evaluate three open-source models, Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B, via local deployment across 320 clinical scenarios spanning ten medical specialties, yielding 960 model-scenario pairs assessed under paired baseline and validation-repair conditions. First, schema noncompliance is consistent across the three model families, with baseline compliance rates ranging from 85.9 to 91.6 percent despite varying architectures and training data, suggesting shared gaps in medical training corpora rather than model-specific limitations. Second, 96 percent of validator-detected failures are representation-level format violations such as alternative medical abbreviations and code prefixes, indicating models follow clinical writing conventions but lack awareness of healthcare IT standards. Third, the validation-repair framework achieves 99.0 percent overall compliance, ranging from 98.4 to 99.4 percent across models, with most errors resolving within one or two iterations. Exact McNemar p-values below 0.001 and absolute improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points across model sizes confirm statistical significance. These results support closed-loop validation-repair as an effective system-level safeguard for healthcare interoperability, improving schema-level readiness for downstream clinical system integration.

</details>


### [256] [LEX-EC: A Lexical Evidence-Channel Audit Framework for Zero-Shot LLM Personality Classification in Black-Box Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24435)
*Brittany Harbison,Ashok K. Goel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LEX-EC框架，通过词汇消融等方法评估大模型在人格标签任务中的可解释性，发现不同类型文本中特质关联信号的强弱差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型能轻易从文本中分配人格标签，但模型的可解释性仍然是一个开放问题，缺乏系统性的黑盒审计方法。

Method: 提出LEX-EC框架，结合患病率与一致性诊断、可控词汇消融（遮蔽话题/人口学/功能词/情感词/认知风格词汇），并引入语言提示扰动，评估模型解释的敏感性。

Result: 自由文本信号最广泛但仍微弱；毕业生的自我介绍中Extraversion关联在遮蔽后减弱；单条Facebook状态几乎无稳定证据。遮蔽话题和人口学内容削弱某些关联，但功能词、情感词和认知风格词汇保留部分可检测信号。语言提示改变了模型自解释但未消除话题内容。

Conclusion: LEX-EC框架联合评估分类患病率、项目级关联、机会校正一致性、词汇限制下的持久性及提示敏感性，为黑盒模型人格标签的可解释性提供了新的词汇分析方法。

Abstract: Large language models may easily assign personality labels from text, but model interpretability remains an open problem. To address this gap, we introduce LEX-EC, a reusable black-box audit framework combining prevalence and agreement diagnostics with controlled lexical ablation to distinguish marginal-distribution effects from trait-associated signal recoverable under restricted evidence. Using this framework, we illustrate how various text genres may exhibit sharply different profiles: free-form essay text contains the broadest, but still weak, signal; in graduate student introductions, an observable Extraversion association weakened after masking; and single Facebook statuses yield little stable evidence even in a trait-balanced sample, indicating a possible lower bound of content or length. Masking topical and demographic content weakened some associations while leaving others detectable from function words, affective terms, and cognitive-style vocabulary. Linguistic prompting shifted model self-explanations but did not eliminate topical content. LEX-EC jointly evaluates classification prevalence, item-level association, chance-corrected agreement, persistence under lexical restriction, and prompt sensitivity in model-generated explanations. Across datasets, models, and prompts, LEX-EC characterizes how trait associations may vary with available lexical evidence, introducing a novel application of lexical methods to black-box interpretability in personality labeling.

</details>


### [257] [Grounding latent algorithm routing in transformer reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24471)
*Xiangbo Zhang,Xiaoxu Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ROUTEBENCH基准，研究Transformer能否在上下文学习中发展出隐式算法路由能力（即根据数据生成机制动态选择不同的归纳偏好族）。实验表明，306M参数模型达到了84.1的路由F1分数，关闭了80.9%的oracle路由差距，且该行为在自然语言变体下保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究Transformer在上下文学习中是否能够发展出类似"路由"的能力——即根据潜在的数据生成机制动态切换不同的归纳偏好族（如全局收缩、稀疏性、鲁棒性、局部性），而非仅依赖单一策略。

Method: 设计ROUTEBENCH诊断基准，包含四种归纳偏好族（ridge-like、lasso-like、Huber-like、kNN-like），训练密集decoder-only Transformer模型（44M-612M参数），评估其算法路由能力，并通过探测控制、激活修补控制等分析内部表征。

Result: 306M模型路由F1达84.1，关闭80.9%的oracle路由差距；该效应在自然语言渲染、扰动下保持稳健；强自适应替代方法仍低于该模型；内部路由相关方向可解码且功能相关。

Conclusion: 密集Transformer在ROUTEBENCH上可发展出类路由的内部变量，但该发现不能推广到预训练大模型或开放自然语言推理中的通用路由能力。

Abstract: A central question in the in-context learning literature is whether transformers can organize episode-level adaptation around different inductive-bias families. We study this question in a controlled setting through latent algorithm routing: route-like behavior in which the solver-family preference changes with the latent data-generating regime while prompt form is held fixed, remains stable under nuisance perturbations, and is selectively influenced by targeted activation interventions without large losses in answer quality. We introduce ROUTEBENCH, a diagnostic benchmark whose regimes differentially favor global shrinkage, sparsity, robustness, and locality, operationalized by ridge-like, lasso-like, Huber-like, and kNN-like family representatives. Across dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch at 44M-612M parameters, a 306M model closes 80.9 percent of the oracle-routing gap and achieves route F1 of 84.1. The effect remains substantial under natural-language renderings, shuffled supports, lexical paraphrases, and a unified four-way routing setting. Stronger adaptive alternatives, including an input-conditioned soft mixture and an unsupervised Gumbel router, narrow the gap but remain below the 306M and 612M models on route F1 and OOD performance. Probe controls and matched activation-patching controls further show that route-relevant internal directions are decodable and functionally involved in solver-family-consistent output behavior. These results provide controlled evidence that dense transformers trained on ROUTEBENCH can develop route-like internal variables, but they do not establish universal routing in pretrained language models or unrestricted natural-language reasoning.

</details>


### [258] [SINT-Flow: Schema Integration using Large Language Model Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24492)
*Keti Korini,Christian Bizer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SINT-Flow 是一个基于 LLM 的五操作符模式集成框架，能够自动将多个去规范化表分解为实体关系并生成统一全局模式。配合 SINT-Bench 基准测试，在 GPT-5.2 和 Qwen-3.6-27B 上取得了高 F1 分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模式集成方法无法处理描述多种实体类型的去规范化源表，且缺乏自动化端到端方案，因此需要设计一个能自动分解并集成这类复杂表格的框架。

Method: 提出 SINT-Flow，由五个 LLM 操作符组成，可组合成工作流自动完成模式集成。核心是将去规范化表分解为实体特定的关系，并结合自一致性策略和审查循环提升匹配质量。

Result: 在 SINT-Bench 基准（10 个任务，93 张表）上，GPT-5.2 和 Qwen-3.6-27B 取得了实体类型检测 F1≥96%，属性检测 F1≥85%，模式映射 F1≥83%。消融实验验证了自一致性策略和审查循环的有效性。

Conclusion: SINT-Flow 实现了全自动、端到端的模式集成，有效解决了去规范化表的分解问题，且开源模型也能达到较高性能，具有良好的实用性和可扩展性。

Abstract: The goal of schema integration is, given a set of input schemata or tables, to derive a global, unified schema that is able to represent the concepts, attributes, and relationships of all input tables in a coherent fashion. This paper presents SINT-Flow, a schema integration framework composed of five LLM-based operators that can be combined into workflows to perform fully automated, end-to-end schema integration. In contrast to existing approaches, SINT-Flow can process denormalized source tables that contain attributes describing multiple entity types. During the schema integration process, these tables are decomposed into separate entity-specific relations. To evaluate SINT-Flow, we introduce SINT-Bench, a schema integration benchmark comprising 10 schema integration tasks consisting of altogether 93 relational tables, including tables that describe multiple types of entities. We evaluate SINT-Flow using GPT-5.2 as well as the open-weight model Qwen-3.6-27B as alternative backbone models. Using these models, SINT-Flow achieves F1 scores of at least 96% for entity-type detection, 85% for attribute detection, and 83% for schema mapping. Furthermore, we perform an ablation study to prove the utility of the applied self-consistency strategy as well as the inclusion of a review loop into the schema matching operator.

</details>


### [259] [Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models and Transformer-Based Machine Translation for English-Tamil and Tamil-English Across Diverse Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24515)
*Sriharshaa S,Sangeetha Sivanesan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种多语言翻译模型（NLLB、mBART、TamilLaMA）在英语-泰米尔语低资源语言翻译上的表现，发现数据集质量和领域对齐显著影响模型性能，注意力分析可提升模型可解释性，且基于上下文提示的少样本LLM能生成结构连贯的泰米尔语翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（如泰米尔语）的机器翻译面临平行数据稀缺、领域多样性和形态复杂性等挑战，现有研究缺乏对这些因素的全面评估。

Method: 在NTREX、EnTamV2、WikiMatrix和PMIndia四个数据集上，使用BLEU和chrF指标评估NLLB和mBART监督系统；通过注意力可视化分析编码器-解码器对齐；利用TamilLaMA进行上下文少样本翻译并与监督方法定性对比。

Result: ①数据集质量与领域对齐度是影响翻译性能的关键因素；②注意力机制可视化能有效提升模型可解释性；③少样本LLM（TamilLaMA）可生成结构上连贯的泰米尔语译文，但与监督系统仍有差距。

Conclusion: 低资源语言翻译应重视数据质量与领域匹配，注意力分析有助于理解模型行为，少样本大模型作为监督方法的补充具有潜力。

Abstract: The challenge of Machine Translation for low resource languages such as Tamil is primarily caused by the restricted amount of parallel data for these languages, as well as their substantial amount of domain variation and morphological complexity. This research presents the comprehensive evaluation of the performance of several multilingual translation models on English-Tamil and Tamil-English translations across multiple datasets: NTREX, EnTamV2, WikiMatrix and PMIndia. This study evaluates supervised NMT systems, NLLB and mBART, using both the BLEU and chrF metric, and examines how these systems perform on data of different quality levels and domains. This performs an attention-based analysis to increase model interpretability by visualising the alignments of tokens in an English source text and their Tamil translations and vice-versa to provide insight into how they make translations. This study also demonstrates that using in-context prompting can provide an excellent way to perform a few-shot translation of English to Tamil and Tamil-English using a Tamil capable TamilLaMA model, and compare this to supervised approaches qualitatively. These findings show that the quality of the datasets and their alignment with the domain will greatly affect the performance of the model, that attention-based mechanisms can aid in explain ability, and that few-shot large language models can still produce structurally coherent translations of Tamil.

</details>


### [260] [From transcription to semantic corpus analysis: unsupervised learning of sentence representations for ancient languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24542)
*Th{é}otime de la Selle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究两种无监督句子嵌入方法（TSDAE和CSE），将古语言模型适配为语料库专用句子编码器，在教父文献中圣经引用识别任务上超越多语言、专门化、蒸馏和监督微调基线，并提供了在线工具Paraphrasis。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动文本识别（ATR）为数字人文学科提供了大量古语言文本，但下游语义分析（如文本复用识别）依赖句子嵌入，现有方法存在三大问题：通用多语言编码器表现不佳、专门语言模型产生各向异性的表示空间、缺乏标注相似度数据。因此需要无监督适配方法。

Method: 采用两种完全无监督策略——TSDAE（去噪自编码）和对比句子嵌入（CSE），将专门化的token级语言模型适配为语料库专用的句子编码器。将圣经引用识别分解为二元检测和对应检索两个子任务，在包含2,935个专家验证的拉丁语和古希腊语平行的教父文献（奥古斯丁、杰罗姆、亚他那修）上进行评估，并与多语言、专门化、蒸馏和监督微调基线对比，同时测试模拟HTR伪影和抄写缩写的噪声数据。

Result: 适配编码器在两个任务上均超越所有基线，且表现互补：TSDAE在领域语料充足时检测最优；CSE在检索任务领先，仅需4-8k原始领域句子（在笔记本GPU上训练几十秒）即可达到最佳，并能跨作品和作者迁移，在噪声ATR文本上重训后表现良好。

Conclusion: 无监督句子嵌入适配策略有效解决古语言文本语义分析难题，UMAP图集揭示了每种策略的几何效应与性能提升之间的关系，完整流程通过在线工具Paraphrasis开放给非专业用户使用。

Abstract: Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) now supplies digital humanities with large volumes of unstructured, heterogeneous, and often noisy text in ancient languages. Downstream semantic analysestext reuse identification, alignment, and semantic search-rely on sentence embeddings, yet existing methods transfer poorly to ancient languages: generic multilingual encoders underperform, specialized language models yield anisotropic representation spaces, and labeled similarity data is unavailable. We study two fully unsupervised strategies - TSDAE and contrastive sentence embedding (CSE) - that adapt a specialized token-level language model into a corpus-specific sentence encoder using only raw sentences. On the philologically central case of biblical reuse in patristic literature (2,935 expert-verified parallels in Latin and Ancient Greek, from Augustine, Jerome, and Athanasius), we decompose reuse identification into two separately evaluated tasks-binary detection and correspondence retrieval-and benchmark the adapted encoders against multilingual, specialized, distilled, and supervised fine-tuned baselines, as well as on artificially noised data simulating HTR artifacts and scribal abbreviations. The adapted encoders outperform all baselines on both tasks, with complementary profiles: TSDAE leads detection given a large in-domain corpus, while CSE leads retrieval, reaches its optimum with as few as 4-8k raw in-domain sentences-a few tens of seconds of training on a laptop GPU-and transfers across works and authors, including to noisy post-ATR text when retrained directly on it. UMAP atlases relate the geometric effect of each strategy to the measured gains, and the full pipeline-segmentation, fine-tuning, cross-corpus semantic search-is made available to non-specialists through the online tool Paraphrasis.

</details>


### [261] [From Data to Device: ELMOD An Efficient German-First 2.7B Language Model for Mobile Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24585)
*Darina Gold,Alexander Schwirjow,Viktor Haag,Viktor Hangya,Joel Schlotthauer,Fabian Küch,Luzian Hahn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ELMOD是一个2.7B参数的高效德语语言模型，在有限计算预算下使用公开数据训练，通过德语专用数据预处理和质量过滤提升效果，在<3B参数规模中表现最佳，性能可媲美7B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型在处理德语时缺乏针对其形态变化、复合词和正字法惯例的专门优化，且需要探索在资源受限设备上高效部署紧凑型德语模型的可行性。

Method: 1) 设计德语专用数据预处理流程，处理形态变化、复合词和正字法; 2) 引入质量过滤与重述步骤提升教学数据质量; 3) 在有限预算(55k H100 GPU小时)下使用公开数据训练2.7B参数模型。

Result: ELMOD在<3B参数规模德语模型中表现最佳，性能可媲美7B参数模型。

Conclusion: 通过针对性的数据预处理和质量提升策略，紧凑型语言模型可以在资源受限条件下获得与其规模不匹配的高性能。

Abstract: We present ELMOD - Efficient Language Model for On-Device Deployment - a compact (2.7B) German language model designed for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. ELMOD was trained on a limited computational budget (55k H100 GPU hours) using exclusively publicly available data. We developed a suite of German-specific data pre-processing, which differ from English-oriented counterparts in their handling of morphological variation, compounding, and orthographic conventions. Furthermore, we introduced a quality filtering and rephrasing step, which increased the instructional quality of the data, improved performance during the annealing phase, and reduced overall compute requirements. Thanks to our architectural model and data choices, including prefiltering, our educational-quality filtering and rephrasal to raise the educational-quality, ELMOD is the strongest performer in its size class (<3B), matching the performance of 7B-parameter models in German.

</details>


### [262] [D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24586)
*Bianca Raimondi,Davide Evangelista,Maurizio Gabbrielli,Elena Loli Piccolomini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出D-Score，一种基于隐藏激活矩阵奇异值分布的轻量级幻觉检测方法，仅需单次前向传播即可判断LLM输出是否包含幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的流畅文本常包含虚假、无证据支持或与模型内部表征不一致的内容（幻觉），现有检测方法依赖外部验证器、检索或多轮生成，效率较低。

Method: D-Score通过单次前向传播计算隐藏激活矩阵的奇异值分布，统计与最大奇异值相近的奇异方向数量作为幻觉分数。当模型处理与内部状态冲突的文本时，隐藏表示会沿额外奇异方向分散，导致D-Score升高。

Result: 在FAVA-Annotation和RAGTruth数据集上，D-Score作为隐藏状态信号在幻觉检测中表现强劲。

Conclusion: D-Score是一种有效的幻觉检测方法，无需外部验证器、检索或多步生成，仅依赖模型内部几何信息即可完成检测。

Abstract: Large Language Models can produce fluent text that is false, unsupported by the available evidence, or inconsistent with information that appears to be internally represented by the model. We study hallucination detection from the geometry of hidden activations and introduce the D-Score, a simple spectral statistic computed from a single forward pass. For a fixed model, layer, and tolerance parameter, the D-Score counts how many singular directions of the hidden activation matrix have singular values that remain close to the leading one. We use this quantity as a hallucination score, classifying an input text as hallucinated when its D-Score is larger than a pre-defined quantity. The motivation is that, when a model processes a text that conflicts with information available in its own internal state, the hidden representation may encode both the asserted content and some form of counter-evidence, uncertainty, correction, or lack of support; this can make the hidden trajectory spread across additional singular directions. We formalize this intuition through a lightweight spectral argument and evaluate the resulting detector on FAVA-Annotation and RAGTruth. The experiments indicate that the D-Score is a strong hidden-state signal for hallucination detection, while requiring no external verifier, no retrieval step, and no multiple generations.

</details>


### [263] [PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24593)
*Hong Liu,Yuan Cheng,Lin Niu,Yi Su,Yufei Xue,Anmin Liu,Guanghua Yu,Jianchen Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PIVOT，一种无需训练的代理索引方法，通过将邻近查询分组共享前缀扫描，在保持精度的前提下将DeepSeek Sparse Attention的索引器加速最高4倍，端到端延迟减少最高1.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSeek Sparse Attention虽然使下游注意力计算高效，但瓶颈转移到了索引器——它需要为每个查询对所有前序token评分（O(L²)复杂度），存在大量冗余。

Method: 利用邻近查询的top-k高度重叠以及索引器评分沿key轴呈长尾分布的特性，将一组邻近查询聚合成一个代理查询，共享一次完整前缀扫描获得候选集，再从中为每个查询选择top-k。包含PIVOT-Reuse（直接共享top-k）和PIVOT-Refine（重新评分候选集）两个变体。

Result: 在DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5.1上，在LongBench和RULER基准测试中，PIVOT匹配了密集DSA索引器的准确率，同时将其加速最多4倍，端到端延迟降低最多1.6倍。

Conclusion: PIVOT通过分组共享策略有效消除了索引器的冗余计算，是一种训练无关的即插即用方案，显著提升了长序列场景下的稀疏注意力效率。

Abstract: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it. To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. We observe that this per-query scan is largely redundant: nearby queries select highly overlapping top-k tokens, and the indexer scores are long-tailed along the key axis. We exploit these properties in PIVOT, Proxy Indexing Via One full-prefix Traversal, a training-free, drop-in replacement for the DSA indexer that shares one prefix scan across a group of nearby queries. PIVOT aggregates a group into a single proxy query, performs one shared full-prefix scan to obtain a candidate set, and then selects a top-k for each query from that set. Two variants trade speed for fidelity: PIVOT-Reuse shares the proxy top-k across the group for maximum speed, whereas PIVOT-Refine re-scores the candidate set with the indexer of each query and then selects an individual top-k, matching the dense indexer at a small additional cost. A single algorithm covers both inference phases, differing only in how groups are formed: fixed-size groups of consecutive queries in prefill, and the queries decoded together in one multi-token prediction (MTP) step in decode. On DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 across LongBench and RULER, PIVOT matches the accuracy of the dense DSA indexer while accelerating it by up to 4x and reducing end-to-end latency by up to 1.6x at long context.

</details>


### [264] [Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24604)
*Xueping Gao,Jianwei Yang,Qiang Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了代码智能体在生成-测试-修正循环中的可靠性问题，发现重复修正并不能保证正确性，反而可能因过时痕迹导致性能下降。通过多项实验论证了正确补丁的保留、验证和提交与找到补丁之间存在显著差距，并提出了基于证据的循环契约和可执行规范实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体常用的生成-测试-修正循环虽然能提高找到正确补丁的概率，但重复本身不提供可靠性保证。现有研究忽视了"找到正确补丁"与"保留、验证并提交它"之间的差距，即正确补丁可能在后续迭代中被丢弃或覆盖。

Method: 通过三类实验设计：（1）种子密封研究：HumanEval上30个修复的900条三修订轨迹；（2）共同状态研究：2430条来自相同冻结程序的分支，消除事后风险集偏差；（3）仓库实验：24个bug和4种编码器栈。在此基础上提出分离的可靠性框架（准入、保存、基于证据的认证、胜任力、活性），并推导出带类型循环契约，实现其机械可实施子集。

Result: 强制修订下，当前正确率从一次修订后的0.820降至两次后的0.673，但"曾经正确"上升至0.847。在14B复制实验中，过时痕迹损害了34/135正确起点，而当前痕迹仅为4/135，差异22.2个百分点（95% CI [8.9,37.0]，p=0.0337）。前瞻性540次策略消除了正确起点的损害，但损害了错误起点的修复。仓库实验呈现地板效应和组件异质性。

Conclusion: 代码修复循环中，过时痕迹会对正确起点造成实质性损害。需要将可靠性分离为多个独立维度，并通过基于证据的循环契约提供机械可执行保障。所提出的参考实现是可执行规范，但本身不证明修复能力的提升或校准的验证器依赖。

Abstract: Generate--test--revise loops are common in coding agents, but repetition alone provides no reliability guarantee. We study the gap between finding a correct patch and retaining, verifying, and submitting it. A sealed five-seed study over 30 HumanEval repairs produces 900 three-revision trajectories. Under forced revision, current correctness with current traces falls from 0.820 after one revision to 0.673 after two, although ever-correct rises to 0.847. Two common-state studies use 2,430 branches from identical frozen programs to remove post-treatment risk-set bias. In a prespecified 14B replication, stale traces harm 34/135 correct starts versus 4/135 with current traces, a 22.2-point increase (task-cluster 95\% CI $[8.9,37.0]$, exact Holm $p=0.0337$). A prospective 540-rollout policy eliminates observed correct-start harm but reduces wrong-start repair and fails its joint criterion. Repository experiments over 24 bugs and four coder stacks expose floor effects and component heterogeneity without Holm-significant effects. We therefore separate admission, preservation, grounded certification, competence, and liveness. We derive an evidence-bound typed loop contract and instantiate its mechanically enforceable subset in a reference implementation that binds verifier evidence to exact code states, preserves verified checkpoints, and emits auditable admission receipts. The implementation is an executable specification and conformance artifact, not evidence of improved repair competence or calibrated verifier dependence.

</details>

Zhang,Yangkun Zhang,Ye Zhang,Yichi Zhang,Yikun Zhang,Yizhi Zhang,Yongting Zhang,Yu Zhang,Yutao Zhang,Yutong Zhang,Zheng Zhang,Zijing Zhang,Bin Zhao,Chenguang Zhao,Feifan Zhao,Jinglun Zhao,Jinxiang Zhao,Shuai Zhao,Wenshuo Zhao,Xiangyu Zhao,Xuanle Zhao,Yikai Zhao,Zijia Zhao,Haozhi Zheng,Huabin Zheng,Ruihan Zheng,Shaojie Zheng,Tengyang Zheng,Haofeng Zhong,Lei Zhong,Longguang Zhong,M. Zhou,Qiankang Zhou,Runjie Zhou,Ruozhang Zhou,Xinyu Zhou,Yiqiao Zhou,Zaida Zhou,Jinguo Zhu,Liya Zhu,Xinhao Zhu,Yangjunfeng Zhu,Yuxuan Zhu,Zhen Zhu,Chen Zhuang,Weiyu Zhuang,Xinxing Zu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Kimi K3是一个2.8T参数的混合专家模型，拥有1040亿激活参数、原生视觉能力和100万token上下文窗口。通过Kimi Delta Attention、Attention Residuals、Stable LatentMoE等技术改进，相比Kimi K2实现了约2.5倍的缩放效率提升。该模型在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，优于其他开源和专有模型，但整体仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol。已完全开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建更大规模、更高效的多模态大语言模型，通过架构创新和训练优化提升缩放效率，缩小与顶级专有模型的差距，并在开源社区推动前沿智能的普及。

Method: 1) 架构：Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) + Attention Residuals改善信息流动；Stable LatentMoE每token激活896个路由专家中的16个。2) 训练：算法-系统协同设计实现完美专家并行负载均衡；精细化的训练配方与数据策略。3) 后训练：跨通用、智能体、编程域的强化学习，支持多种推理努力水平，实现组合泛化与长程执行。4) 基础设施：百万token智能体RL（持久化rollout与沙盒状态）、高效内存管理、部署创新。

Result: 在2.8T参数规模下，Kimi K3在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，优于评估套件中所有其他开源和专有模型，但整体性能仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol。

Conclusion: Kimi K3通过架构与训练创新实现了显著的缩放效率提升，在多个任务上达到前沿水平，并开源全部权重以促进后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.

</details>


### [266] [DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24717)
*Zhen Huang,Yikun Wang,Shijie Xia,Pengfei Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DataOrchestra是一个面向大语言模型预训练数据的智能处理框架，能够为每个数据样本动态定制个性化的清洗或处理流程，在多个规模模型（0.5B-7B）和11个基准上持续优于固定策略方法，同时通过跳过不必要的操作降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练数据处理方法通常采用固定的、全局统一的策略（如按领域或语料级别设定），无法根据每个数据样本的具体特征进行自适应调整，导致处理效率低下且效果受限。

Method: 提出DataOrchestra框架，包含一个编排器（orchestrator），对每个数据块依次做三个层面的决策：1）是否丢弃、保留原样或清洗；2）若需清洗，选择从程序化编辑到基于LLM重写等多种下游操作；3）对每一次重写步骤，生成具体的指令，由对应的工具模型执行。

Result: 在0.5B到7B规模模型上从头预训练，在11个基准测试中持续优于单个数据处理方法；在数学继续预训练任务上也超过更强的处理基线；同时通过跳过不必要的下游操作，减少了处理计算量。

Conclusion: 示例级（example-specific）的动态数据处理管线比统一的固定策略更有效，能够兼顾数据质量提升与计算效率的平衡。

Abstract: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. Given a chunk of pretraining data, an orchestrator decides whether to drop, untouch, or clean it. For a chunk to be cleaned, it selects one or more downstream operations, ranging from programmatic editing to different forms of LLM-based rewriting. For each rewriting step, it further generates a concrete instruction, which is executed by the corresponding downstream tool model. We pretrain models from 0.5B to 7B from scratch on web data processed by DataOrchestra and observe stable average gains over individual data-processing methods across 11 benchmarks. DataOrchestra is also effective for math continued pretraining and outperforms stronger processing baselines, while reducing processing compute by skipping unnecessary downstream operations.

</details>


### [267] [The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24720)
*Tianyi Men,Zhuoran Jin,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过一个统一可控的多轮环境，系统研究了基础模型智能体在长程规划中的能力获取、塑造与整合三阶段机制，揭示了数据质量、后训练方法与多教师蒸馏对规划能力的影响规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型依赖不可控且不透明的互联网数据训练，难以识别长程规划能力是如何获得、塑造和整合的，缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 构建统一可控的多轮环境，分三阶段研究：(1)预训练阶段：控制数据格式、分布和质量；(2)后训练阶段：对比GRPO和OPD方法，分析规划模式与知识；(3)多教师蒸馏阶段：提出MOPD方法研究能力整合。

Result: (1)CoT状态转换建模增强泛化；少量长程数据即可实现组合泛化；次优轨迹严重损害性能。(2)OPD在低质量和长程设置下优于GRPO；不同知识教师蒸馏可能损害学生已有世界模型。(3)MOPD通过收敛到共享规划模式实现跨环境泛化；部分共享支持持续学习；完全冲突导致严重干扰。

Conclusion: 长程规划能力的系统性提升需要在预训练中重视世界模型构建和数据质量，在后训练中选择合适的策略方法，以及通过多教师蒸馏有效整合不同能力。

Abstract: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. (1) Planning ability acquisition during pre-training. We study data format, distribution, and quality. Explicit world model construction through CoT state transition modeling yields stronger long-horizon generalization. Atomic skills alone are insufficient for compositional generalization, whereas a litte long-horizon data works. Moreover, suboptimal trajectories severely impair performance because errors amplify over long horizons. (2) Planning ability shaping via GRPO and OPD post-training. Through mutual information, we distinguish general planning patterns from task-specific planning knowledge. For planning patterns, we identify three application regions of post-training: unnecessary, effective, and unsupported. OPD has a broader effective region than GRPO under low-quality and long-horizon settings, as it provides more consistent update directions. For planning knowledge, distilling unseen procedures from a teacher with different knowledge may impair student's prior world modeling without fully establishing new knowledge. (3) Planning ability integration through MOPD post-training. We show that multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates capabilities by converging to shared planning-pattern across environments. Compatible patterns enable cross-environment generalization, partially shared patterns support continual learning, while completely conflicting patterns cause severe interference.

</details>


### [268] [Creative Integration: A Decidable Criterion of Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13977)
*Yoshinori Nomura*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可判定的"创造性整合"标准：当且仅当在固定描述语言下，解决A与B之间真实冲突的描述长度严格缩短（C>1），且缩减定位于冲突本身时，该解决方案才算真正的创造性整合。作者通过四个二值合取门使判断可判定，并通过伪整合分类法界定其外延。验证不依赖人类评分者一致性，而是通过四项可证伪测试（独立计算检验、硬负例区分、样本外预测、描述语言鲁棒性），均通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前"整合性"解决方案广受赞誉但缺乏操作性定义——无法区分真正的整合（使世界描述更简洁）与精致的重述。

Method: 基于创造性/智能即压缩的思想谱系，提出"创造性整合"判据：在固定描述语言下，解决真实冲突后描述长度严格缩短（C = L_pre/L_post > 1），且缩减量定位于冲突本身。通过四个二值合取门实现可判定性，并通过伪整合分类法排除假阳性。

Result: 构建了多领域语料库，四项可证伪测试均以余量通过：独立计算检验、硬负例区分、样本外预测、描述语言鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 真正的创造性在于压缩冲突，新颖性和价值只是下游症状。贡献不在于"创造性即压缩"，而在于其可判定性、区分能力和语料库。文中明确将此主张作为可检验的猜想提出。

Abstract: "Integrative" solutions are widely praised but rarely defined: we lack an operational way to tell a genuine integration -- one that makes the world cheaper to describe -- from a tidy re-description. Building on the lineage that
  treats creativity and intelligence as compression, we give such a criterion for creative integration (CI): the resolution of a real conflict between A and B is CI if and only if, under a fixed description language, the description
  length strictly shrinks (C = L_pre/L_post > 1), with the reduction located in the conflict itself. We make the judgment decidable through four binary, conjunctive gates, and we fix its extension through a taxonomy of
  pseudo-integration that names and rejects the look-alikes. We back the criterion with a curated, multi-domain corpus and -- crucially -- validate it not by human inter-rater agreement but by four falsifiable tests it could fail: an
  independent computational check, discrimination against hard negatives, out-of-sample prediction, and description-language robustness; all pass with margin. The contribution is not "creativity is compression" but its decidability,
  discrimination, and corpus: on this account, what makes a move genuinely creative -- rather than merely novel -- is that it compresses a conflict, with novelty and value as downstream symptoms; whether all creativity is so
  constituted we state as an explicit conjecture. We claim only the sign of C-1; we judge, not generate. The result is a citable primitive for a broader program.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [269] [Semalith v1.4: A Calibrated 184M Safety Classifier Achieving State-of-the-Art Prompt-Injection Detection at 44x Fewer Parameters than Llama-Guard-3-8B](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22545)
*Tejasvi C. Addagada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Semalith v1.4 是一个184M参数的DeBERTa-v3-base安全分类器，可在单次推理中同时检测提示注入、一般危害和金融合规三类风险（22个细分类别），在22个基准测试中以比Llama-Guard-3-8B少44倍的参数取得7/7提示注入胜利和11/18总体胜利，且良性提示误报率为0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开源安全护栏无法在同一次推理中同时处理提示注入、监管合规和一般危害三类安全问题，尤其是在金融服务和智能体场景下存在空白。

Method: 基于DeBERTa-v3-base（184M参数）的多标签分类器，包含22类主分类头（良性、9种提示注入子类、一般危害、11种BFSI金融标签）和4类辅助超类别头，采用联合加权损失训练。训练集来自49个公开来源的76,204条语料，并通过SHA-1去重确保21/22基准零污染。

Result: 在22个保留基准上，Semalith v1.4以44倍少的参数在7/7提示注入评估和11/18总体基准上击败Llama-Guard-3-8B。良性智能体提示误报率0.000（vs 0.063）。在一般危害基准上Llama-Guard-3领先，形成互补格局。论文同时披露了6个已知弱点。

Conclusion: Semalith v1.4有效填补了单次推理中多轴安全分类的空白。v1.3推荐用于对话审核场景，v1.4推荐用于需要金融标签覆盖或良性提示零误报的场景。

Abstract: Deploying large language models in financial-services and agentic settings requires safety classifiers that simultaneously handle prompt injection, regulatory compliance, and general harm, a combination no existing open guardrail addresses in a single inference pass.
  Semalith v1.4 is a 184M-parameter DeBERTa-v3-base classifier performing simultaneous three-axis safety classification including prompt injection, general harm, and financial-services regulatory compliance, in a single forward pass. Its 22-class head (BENIGN, nine prompt-injection sub-types, general-harm, eleven BFSI labels) is trained with a 4-class auxiliary super-category head under jointly weighted loss, on a 76,204-row corpus mined from 49 public sources with SHA-1 deduplication against every held-out evaluation set, with 21 of 22 benchmarks at zero contamination (max 0.22%).
  Against Llama-Guard-3-8B on 22 held-out benchmarks, Semalith v1.4 wins every prompt-injection evaluation (7/7) and 11 of 18 benchmarks overall at 44x fewer parameters, with FPR = 0.000 on 208 benign agentic prompts vs 0.063 for Llama-Guard-3-8B. On general-harm benchmarks (WildGuardMix, HEx-PHI, HarmBench), Llama-Guard-3 leads; this complementary split is documented in Section 4. Six measured weak spots are disclosed in Section 6.
  Deployment guidance: v1.3 is recommended for conversational moderation deployments (ToxicChat F1 0.624); v1.4 is recommended when BFSI label coverage or zero-FPR on benign agentic prompts is the priority.

</details>


### [270] [CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22711)
*Mingwei Zheng,David OBrien,Siwei Cui,Pardis Pashakhanloo,Rajdeep Mukherjee,Myeongsoo Kim,Sachit Kuhar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CORVUS提出了一种新型轨迹架构，通过解耦文件读取操作与观察结果，维护同步的文件注册表，减少冗余和过时快照，在保持通过率的同时显著降低token消耗和推理循环次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的仅追加式轨迹架构将文件读取操作与观察结果紧密耦合，随着编辑或并发修改，快照变得过时，导致推理错误和冗余重读，使轨迹臃肿。

Method: 提出CORVUS架构，解耦文件读取与观察结果，维护同步的文件注册表，在每个推理周期仅注入当前文件内容。

Result: 在SWE-POLYBENCH_VERIFIED和SWE-BENCH PRO上，平均输入token减少9-50%，最终提示缩短15-32%，推理周期减少最多37%，通过率相当。

Conclusion: CORVUS通过结构性的轨迹架构改进，在保持性能的同时显著提升了LLM编码代理的效率和轨迹质量。

Abstract: LLM coding agents operate by constructing trajectories that accumulate reasoning, tool calls, and results to enable multi-step decision-making. However, the conventional append-only trajectory architecture found in practice tightly couples file-read actions with their observations, capturing snapshots that become permanently fixed in the chronological history. As files change through agent edits or concurrent human modifications, these snapshots become stale, causing reasoning errors and causing agents to redundantly re-read files, with each re-read appending yet another copy to the trajectory. To mitigate this, we propose CORVUS, a novel trajectory architecture that decouples file-read actions from their observations by maintaining a synchronized registry of relevant files and injecting only their current contents at each reasoning cycle. This structural change produces significantly lighter-weight trajectories that remain synchronized with the actual codebase state by construction, eliminating redundant file copies and stale snapshots that bloat conventional trajectories. We evaluated CORVUS on SWE- POLYBENCH_VERIFIED and SWE-BENCH PRO across four LLMs, achieving 9-50% reduction in average input tokens per task, 15-32% shorter final prompts, and up to 37% fewer reasoning cycles while maintaining comparable pass rates.

</details>


### [271] [CausalGate: Causal Importance Distillation for Transformer Module Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22720)
*Kiran Nair,Smriti Regmi,Rodrigue Rizk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CausalGate提出了一种基于因果干预的框架，通过量化每层注意力/MLP子层对最终输出的语义贡献，训练轻量级标量门控实现高效推理，在多个模型上超越现有动态路由方法，且零运行时开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应推理方法依赖隐藏状态相似度、激活幅度等观测相关性指标来丢弃冗余模块，但这些基于相关性的度量无法捕捉对语义准确性至关重要的非线性结构计算，导致误删重要模块。

Method: 在校准阶段，CausalGate逐个隔离注意力/MLP子层并将输出置零，通过KL散度精确衡量语义损伤，建立结构重要性层级；然后利用指数移动平均平滑目标和可微成对排序损失，将重要性层级蒸馏为一组静态轻量标量门控，消除运行时路由开销。

Result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B、Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上的语言建模与常识推理任务中，CausalGate一致优于动态路由和层跳过基线，将理论计算节省转化为实际硬件延迟降低，且零运行开销。

Conclusion: 基于因果干预而非相关性统计的方法能更准确地识别冗余模块，通过蒸馏为静态门控可兼顾高效与效果，为LLM自适应推理提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Existing adaptive inference methods for Large Language Models rely on observational heuristics, such as hidden-state similarity or activation magnitudes, to drop redundant modules. However, these correlation-based metrics often fail to capture subtle, non-linear structural computations vital for semantic accuracy. We introduce CausalGate, an intervention-guided framework for compute-efficient transformer inference. During a calibration phase, CausalGate isolates individual Attention and MLP sub-layers, zeros out their respective outputs, and measures the exact semantic damage via the Kullback-Leibler divergence of the final logit distribution. To eliminate runtime routing overhead, this structural importance hierarchy is distilled into a global set of static, lightweight scalar gates using an Exponential Moving Average smoothing objective paired with a differentiable pairwise ranking loss. Evaluated on TinyLlama-1.1B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.1-8B across language modeling and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, CausalGate consistently outperforms prominent dynamic routing and layer-skipping baselines, translating theoretical compute savings into concrete hardware latency reductions with zero operational overhead.

</details>


### [272] [Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22724)
*Kaibing Yang,Guangfeng Cai,Shengtian Yang,Shuo He,Yu Li,Mengyi Liu,Pengwei Chen,Jun Xu,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProGPO方法，通过在全部失败组中利用首次访问状态覆盖度分配优势，打破强化学习中的信用陷阱，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于组的策略优化方法在长周期任务中存在采样不平衡问题：重复/低效动作占据高概率区域，有用动作采样不足，导致全失败组内无法提供有效的策略修正方向，形成自我强化的信用陷阱。

Method: ProGPO方法：当组内所有样本均获得零结果奖励时，基于首次访问观测覆盖度（first-visit observation coverage）为轨迹或步骤分配更高的相对优势，即访问更多新状态的样本获得更高权重。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个挑战性智能体基准上，使用Qwen2.5-1.5/7B-Instruct模型，ProGPO持续优于基于组的基线方法，尤其在困难任务上提升显著。

Conclusion: ProGPO通过引入状态探索信号作为内在奖励，有效打破了失败主导采样导致的信用陷阱，为长周期稀疏奖励场景下的LLM策略优化提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon tasks, this comparison can suffer from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy while useful state-changing actions remain under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where outcome rewards provide no direction for correcting the policy. Together, these effects can form a self-reinforcing credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no outcome-based correction, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. To break this loop, we propose Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (ProGPO), which uses first-visit observation coverage only when all samples in a group receive zero outcome reward. Specifically, within such groups, ProGPO assigns higher relative advantages to trajectories or steps that visit more new states since reaching new observations is a prerequisite for task success. Experiments on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5/7B-Instruct, show that ProGPO consistently improves over group-based baselines, with particularly large gains on hard tasks.

</details>


### [273] [QFedPolyp: A Communication- and Inference-Efficient Federated Learning Framework for Polyp Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22743)
*Madan Baduwal,Priyanka Paudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QFedPolyp，一种结合量化感知训练与低精度模型通信的联邦学习框架，用于隐私保护的息肉分割，在降低通信成本的同时保持分割精度并加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决集中式深度学习需要共享敏感医疗数据的问题，以及联邦学习中全精度模型参数反复传输带来的高通信成本。

Method: 将量化感知训练与低精度模型通信相结合：各医院本地训练轻量U-Net并模拟量化过程，客户端传输量化后的模型参数，中央服务器使用联邦平均进行聚合重建。

Result: 全精度联邦训练在Kvasir-SEG上达到0.910 Dice，CVC-ClinicVideoDB上达到0.930；均匀8位通信降低约4倍传输成本，分割精度基本持平；量化模型推理速度提升最高1.5倍。

Conclusion: QFedPolyp实现了隐私保护的协作息肉分割，降低了通信开销并加速推理，生成的轻量模型适用于实时临床部署。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Automatic polyp segmentation supports computer-aided diagnosis and early colorectal cancer detec- tion. Centralized deep learning requires hospitals to share sensitive medical data, while federated learning preserves privacy but introduces high communication costs through repeated transmission of full-precision model parameters. We propose QFedPolyp, a communication- and inference-efficient federated learning framework for collaborative polyp segmentation.
  Methods: QFedPolyp combines quantization-aware training with low-precision model communication. Each hospital locally trains a lightweight U-Net on private data while simulating quantization during training. Clients transmit quantized model parameters to a central server, where they are reconstructed and aggregated using Federated Averaging. Evaluation is performed on Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicVideoDB, PolypGen, and BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp.
  Results: Full-precision federated training achieves Dice scores of 0.910 on Kvasir-SEG and 0.930 on CVC-ClinicVideoDB. Uni- form 8-bit communication reduces transmission cost by approximately 4 times while preserving competitive segmentation accuracy. Quantized models also achieve up to 1.5 times faster inference than full-precision models.
  Conclusions: QFedPolyp enables privacy-preserving collaborative polyp segmentation with reduced communication overhead and faster inference. The resulting lightweight models are suitable for real-time clinical deployment.

</details>


### [274] [Learning to Access Computation: Accessibility Plasticity as a Principle of Adaptive Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22748)
*Zhaowen Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"可访问性可塑性"（Accessibility Plasticity）作为神经网络中一种新的自适应维度——系统不仅通过改变计算本身（能力），还通过重新组织已有计算之间的交互路径（可访问性）来适应。实验表明，在序列学习任务中，调整可访问性可减少能力修改，同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络主要依赖参数修改来适应，但缺乏将"计算能力"与"计算可访问性"区分开作为独立自适应变量的机制。

Method: 形式化定义了基于关系的可访问性可塑性操作实现，并建立"重用优先"的适应层级（可访问性修改优先于更昂贵的能力和结构修改）。

Result: 在序列学习任务的概念验证评估中，可访问性自适应能减少能力修改量，同时保持相当的任务性能。

Conclusion: 可访问性是一个独特的自适应维度，为未来计算关系可随环境动态演化的神经动力学系统奠定基础。

Abstract: Modern neural networks primarily adapt through parameter modification within predefined computational structures. While recent methods introduce modularity, conditional computation, and parameter-efficient adaptation, they generally do not distinguish computational capability from computational accessibility as separate adaptive variables. This work introduces Accessibility Plasticity, a principle of adaptive computation in which systems adapt not only by changing what computation exists, but also by reorganizing which existing computations can interact and participate. We formalize Accessibility Plasticity through a relationship-based operational realization and establish a reuse-first hierarchy of adaptation, where accessibility modification precedes more costly capability and structural changes. A proof-of-concept evaluation on sequential learning tasks shows that accessibility adaptation can reduce capability modification while maintaining comparable task performance. These results suggest accessibility as a distinct adaptive dimension and provide a foundation for future dynamic neural systems whose computational relationships evolve with changing environments.

</details>


### [275] [Hierarchical Grading in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22757)
*T. Shaska*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分级大语言模型(GLLMs)，通过代数框架为Transformer表示空间引入分级结构，将加权标量作用通过嵌入、自注意力和训练目标传播。该框架基于几何不变理论，证明最优分级构成一个开凸锥，普通Transformer位于锥边界上。对于层级分层目标，证明了分级先验与无分级先验之间的极小极大分离。每个GLLM最终可编译为架构和推理复杂度相同的标准Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer架构在表示空间中缺乏显式的代数结构来区分不同重要程度的特征。作者希望引入分级代数结构，在不增加计算复杂度的情况下，提升语言模型的表达能力，并建立严格的几何理论基础来解释和优化这种结构。

Method: (1) 将Transformer的表示空间赋予Z-分级结构，通过Kempf-Ness泛函在分级环面上表达分级收益；(2) 利用Hilbert-Mumford型判据确定最优分级方向；(3) 通过两个矩映射的 coincidence 点给出最优分级的闭式解；(4) 建立分级先验与无分级先验的极小极大分离理论。

Result: (1) 最优分级构成一个开凸锥，普通Transformer位于锥边界（半稳定各向同性点）；(2) 对于层级分层目标，分级先验与无分级先验的风险在特定样本量窗口内以指数级因子分离（随层数增加衰减）；(3) 最优分级可在训练前通过凸规划求解；(4) GLLM可编译为标准Transformer，不增加推理复杂度。

Conclusion: 分级结构为Transformer提供了更丰富的代数表达能力，且最优分级可离线求解。关键在于GLLM训练后能退化为标准Transformer，实现了"训练时受益、推理时零开销"的理想特性，为预训练语言模型的结构优化提供了新的理论基础。

Abstract: We introduce Graded Large Language Models (GLLMs), an algebraic framework that equips the representation space of a transformer with a grading and propagates the induced weighted scalar action through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The construction extends the theory of graded neural networks and graded transformers to autoregressive language models while preserving expressive power, asymptotic computational complexity, and inference cost.
  The governing geometric picture is that of geometric invariant theory. The benefit of a grading is expressed by a Kempf--Ness functional on the grading torus; the grades that improve upon the uniform architecture form an open convex cone whose membership is decided by a Hilbert--Mumford-type criterion pairing a grade direction against two measurable profiles of the target and the data; the optimal grades are the coincidence point of two moment maps, given in closed form; and the ordinary transformer appears as a semistable isotropic point on the boundary of the cone: one member of a larger graded family rather than a distinguished optimum.
  Separately, for level-stratified targets we prove a minimax separation between the graded prior and its absence: over all estimators the risks of the graded and uniform target classes separate throughout an explicit window of sample sizes, by a factor that decays exponentially in the number of levels under geometric stratification. Both profiles are estimable offline, so the optimal grades solve a convex program certified before training begins. Because the grading is absorbed into the learned parameters after training, every GLLM compiles to a standard transformer of identical architecture and inference complexity.

</details>


### [276] [An Integrated Deep Learning and Statistical Framework for Whole-Network Gene--Environment Association with Leaf Vascular Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22763)
*Geran Zhao,Yangsheng Wang,Xiaotian Dai,Guifang Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成深度学习与统计学的框架，通过完整提取叶脉网络图像表型并利用截断潜变量高斯Copula模型处理稀疏零膨胀边图数据，结合半参数稀疏典型相关分析识别与叶脉结构显著相关的基因-地理互作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因-环境关联研究仅用少量低维摘要特征量化叶脉形态，丢失了原始图像中大部分结构信息。

Method: 1) 叶脉全网络图像表型表征；2) 微调EDTER深度学习模型提取完整叶脉架构；3) 构建含DiffusionEdge边图和BSDS500的注释叶图像数据库；4) 采用SSCCA进行高维双变量图像响应与预测变量的变量选择和关联建模，用截断潜变量高斯Copula模型处理稀疏零膨胀边图数据。

Result: 两项模拟研究验证了框架在不同复杂度下的性能；实际杨树数据集识别出三个与叶脉结构显著相关的基因-地理互作。

Conclusion: 提供了新的生物学见解，建立了适用于高维复杂图像表型的通用方法论框架。

Abstract: Leaf veins exhibit remarkable diversity in architecture and patterning, yet existing gene--environment association studies have primarily quantified leaf venation using a small collection of low-dimensional summary traits, thereby discarding most of the structural information contained in the original images. We propose an integrated deep learning and statistical framework. The proposed framework achieves four methodological advances. First, it represents the complete leaf vascular architecture as a whole-network image phenotype. Second, it fine-tunes the deep learning-based Edge Detection with Transformers (EDTER) model to accurately extract whole-network leaf vascular architecture from RGB images by jointly learning local and global contextual features. Third, it constructs a new annotated leaf image database by integrating edge maps generated by DiffusionEdge with the Berkeley Segmentation Database (BSDS500). Fourth, it applies Semiparametric Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (SSCCA) to perform variable selection and model associations between repeatedly measured high-dimensional Bivariate image responses and high-dimensional predictors while simultaneously accommodating sparse, zero-inflated data represented by edge maps through a truncated latent Gaussian copula model. Two simulation studies demonstrate the performance of the proposed framework under increasing levels of complexity. Application to a real \emph{Populus} dataset identifies three significant gene--geography interactions associated with leaf vascular architecture, providing new biological insights and establishing a broadly applicable methodological framework for high-dimensional complex image phenotypes.

</details>


### [277] [Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22766)
*Yunting Song,Matthew Watson,Peter Grabowski,Jun Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需重新训练的、基于Shapley值近似的可扩展数据估值管道，通过语义k-NN图映射和条件对数似然变化来评估数据效用，成功在HelpSteer2和HH-RLHF数据集中发现大量隐藏标注错误和安全隐患，并揭露了现有基准测试中的严重标签缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐数据集随着规模扩大，不可避免地积累了结构性矛盾、安全风险和系统性人工标注错误。而传统的去重或LLM-as-a-judge等审计方法无法捕获单个样本对模型预测的实际影响，也无法发现深层的功能性规则冲突。

Method: 提出一个仅需推理的可扩展数据估值管道，通过将语义k-NN邻域映射为有向图，利用参考LLM的零样本和一样本条件对数似然变化来近似Shapley值，评估数据效用，再将预测影响力分数转化为局部优势指标，以隔离梯度冲突的记录。

Result: 在HelpSteer2数据集上，管道将人工审计搜索空间缩减99.1%，成功发现多种失败模式下的错误标注；在Anthropic的HH-RLHF数据集中，自动审计策略发现了数千个隐藏的安全性和偏好反转问题，并暴露出基准测试中强大模型因人类错误标签而被罚分的严重漏洞。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个数学上严谨、高效的数据质量诊断工具，可用于发现人类标注失败、清理评估基准、确保LLM对齐数据的完整性。

Abstract: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality. As datasets scale, massive preference and instruction-tuning corpora inevitably accumulate hidden structural contradictions, safety risks, and systemic human annotation errors. Standard dataset auditing methods, such as semantic deduplication or LLM-as-a-judge, struggle to capture the actual predictive impact of individual records and often miss deep functional rule clashes. To address this, we introduce a scalable, inference-only data valuation pipeline that approximates the Shapley value without iterative model retraining. By mapping semantic k-NN neighborhoods into a directed graph, our framework evaluates data utility directly through a reference LLM's probability distribution using zero-shot and one-shot conditional log-likelihood shifts. Our pipeline then translates these predictive influence scores into localized advantage metrics to isolate gradient-conflicting records. We demonstrate the pipeline's efficacy in sanitizing two heavily vetted alignment datasets. First, applying our pipeline to the HelpSteer2 dataset reduced the manual audit search space by 99.1%, successfully uncovering falsely-labeled records across diverse failure modes. Second, applying our automated audit strategy to Anthropic's HH-RLHF training and evaluation splits identified thousands of hidden safety and factual preference inversions. Crucially, by extending this audit to the evaluation split, we expose severe vulnerabilities in current benchmark integrity: highly capable models frequently predict the safer or more helpful response, only to be penalized by objectively flawed human ground-truth labels. Overall, our work provides a mathematically grounded, highly efficient diagnostic tool to uncover human label failures, sanitize evaluation benchmarks, and ensure the integrity of LLM alignment data.

</details>


### [278] [DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22769)
*He Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DomainPilot: 一种领域级损失引导的两阶段数据混合优化框架，通过约30行代码嵌入现有训练框架，在不增加数据量和训练成本的情况下，在Qwen3-1.7B SFT上取得+2%至+3.8%的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据调度方法在工业级预训练和SFT中面临三大瓶颈：数据选择的O(N)计算成本过高、混合优化存在I/O瓶颈或需训练辅助模型、样本级重加权依赖易于混淆噪声/难度/新颖性的损失信号。亟需一种轻量级、高效的替代方案。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 粗优化阶段（Scaling Law引导），通过拟合领域特异性收敛曲线推导混合比例先验；(2) 细优化阶段（Mixing Law引导），通过控制实验建模领域间交互效应。采用基于patch的架构，仅需~30行适配代码即可注入领域感知损失计算。

Result: Qwen3-1.7B SFT上：MMLU-Redux +2%，AIME24 +1.8%，LiveCodeBench v5 +3.8%，BFCL v3 +3.6%，且不增加数据量和训练成本。

Conclusion: 领域级训练信号为混合优化提供了一种有效、轻量级的替代方案，避免了昂贵的数据选择或辅助模型训练。

Abstract: The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss signals that conflate noise, difficulty, and novelty.
  We present DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. DomainPilot introduces token-level domain loss monitoring to capture per-domain learning dynamics during training without halting the data pipeline. Building on these signals, we propose a Scaling Law guided coarse optimization stage that fits domain-specific convergence curves and derives a principled prior for mixture adjustment. A subsequent Mixing Law guided fine optimization stage refines the mixture by modeling cross-domain interaction effects through controlled sweep experiments. The entire mechanism is realized via a patch-based architecture that injects domain-aware loss computation into existing training frameworks (e.g., MindSpeed/Megatron-LM) with only ~30 lines of framework-specific adapter code.
  We validate DomainPilot on the Qwen3-1.7B model during SFT. Compared to the original data mixture, our optimized mixture achieves improvements of +2% on MMLU-Redux, +1.8% on AIME24, +3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5, and +3.6% on BFCL v3, without increasing total data volume or training cost. These results demonstrate that domain-level training signals provide an effective, lightweight alternative to expensive data selection or auxiliary model training for mixture optimization.

</details>


### [279] [Dementia Etiology Diagnosis via Collaborative Meta Knowledge Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22770)
*Siyuan Du,Mengxi Chen,Xinyang Jiang,Zilong Wang,Jiangchao Yao,Dongsheng Li,Ya Zhang,Lili Qiu,Yanfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了COME框架，通过将多中心采集语义、源标识符和模态指标作为异构性感知嵌入注入统一Transformer架构，并结合信任域约束优化，在7个独立队列中实现了痴呆症病因诊断的SOTA性能（平均宏AUC 85.62%），同时保持跨中心和跨序列的域外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI在痴呆症病因诊断中面临症状重叠和跨中心数据异构性的挑战，传统多任务学习未能有效利用元信息（如站点采集方式、模态可用性）来应对数据异构性。

Method: 1) 异构性感知嵌入：将多中心采集语义、源标识符和模态指标注入统一Transformer架构；2) 信任域约束优化：通过参考模型正则化，防止训练过程中产生虚假关联。

Result: 在7个独立队列中，域内平均宏AUC达85.62%，比最强基线提升4.29个百分点；在跨中心和跨序列评估中保持优越的域外泛化性能；模型预测与淀粉样蛋白、tau蛋白等生物标志物及临床严重程度一致。

Conclusion: COME框架通过显式建模异构性实现了鲁棒且可解释的痴呆症诊断，具有真实世界应用的潜力。

Abstract: Although artificial intelligence (AI) has shown promising performance in several medical tasks, accurate dementia etiology diagnosis with AI remains challenging due to complex overlapping symptoms among diseases. Scaling up the dataset size by combining the cross-center samples may bring a gain in the pursuit of performance, while the inherent data heterogeneity across centers or populations induces the conflict. Conventional multi-task learning paradigms offer a promising framework; however, they fail to consider critical meta information (e.g., site-specific acquisition and modality availability) to combat the heterogeneity. To address this challenge, we propose a Collaborative Meta Knowledge Enhancement (COME) framework for dementia etiology diagnosis, which injects multi-center acquisition semantics, source identifiers, and modality indicators as heterogeneity-aware embeddings into a unified Transformer architecture for scale-up training, enabling explicit modeling of heterogeneity. Besides, a trust-region constrained optimization scheme is designed to regularize the model from spurious correlations during training through a reference model. Across seven independent cohorts, our method achieves state-of-the-art in-domain performance with a mean macro-averaged AUC of 85.62% and a 4.29-point gain over the strongest baseline, while maintaining superior out-of-domain generalization under both cross-center and cross-sequence evaluations. Extensive validation also confirms the alignment between model predictions and established biomarkers (amyloid, tau) and clinical severity, highlighting the potential of COME to enable robust and interpretable dementia diagnostics in real-world settings.

</details>


### [280] [CC-AOS: Cost- and Horizon-Conditioned Amortized Backward Induction for Finite-Horizon Optimal Stopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22774)
*Tianwei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CC-AOS方法，通过条件化摊销拟合反向归纳，实现连续成本和多时间范围下的高效最优停止，在FordA基准上平均降低15.75%的目标值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动反向归纳方法需为每个成本-时间范围操作点单独求解，改变操作条件需重复优化且部署多组模型，无法高效适应连续成本变化和多时间范围部署。

Method: 提出CC-AOS（成本与时间范围条件化摊销最优停止），学习一个以当前状态、绝对时间、剩余时间范围和获取成本为条件的共享延续价值模型，通过联合摊销拟合反向归纳实现。将值函数和延续函数的单调性、凹性及Lipschitz性质编码到模型架构中，并推导基于残差的值函数和策略误差界。

Result: 在6个未见过的FordA成本-时间范围对中，单个CC-AOS模型在所有6个点上均优于独立训练的Convex Function Learning，平均目标值降低15.75%，且平均表现与调优的静态阈值法持平。

Conclusion: CC-AOS通过条件化共享模型实现对连续成本和多时间范围的高效最优停止，避免重复优化，且理论上有误差界保证。

Abstract: Finite-horizon optimal stopping is a central problem in early time-series classification, where a system must decide at each sequence prefix whether the expected benefit of another observation justifies its acquisition cost. Existing data-driven backward-induction methods typically solve each cost-horizon operating point separately, so changing operating conditions requires repeated optimization and separate model stacks, making continuous cost adaptation and multi-horizon deployment inefficient. We propose CC-AOS (Cost- and Horizon-Conditioned Amortized Optimal Stopping), a structured amortized solver for a family of finite-horizon stopping problems with continuous costs and multiple horizons. CC-AOS learns a shared continuation-value model conditioned on the current state, absolute time, remaining horizon, and acquisition cost through joint amortized fitted backward induction. We establish that the exact value and continuation functions are nondecreasing, concave, and horizon-dependently Lipschitz in cost, encode these properties in the model architecture, and derive residual-based bounds on value and policy errors. Experiments on controlled Gaussian and time-varying non-Gaussian processes and the FordA engine-noise time-series benchmark compare CC-AOS with representative per-operating-point backward-induction solvers and tuned static stopping rules. At six unseen FordA cost-horizon pairs, one CC-AOS checkpoint achieved a lower terminal-risk-plus-sampling-cost objective than independently fitted Convex Function Learning at all six pairs, with an average reduction of 15.75 percent, while matching the tuned static thresholds on average.

</details>


### [281] [Predicting the Outcome of rTMS Depression Therapy using EEG Signals and CNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22776)
*Wael Korani,Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury,Sadam AlQadi,Priyan Malarvizhi kumar,Reza Rostami,Reza Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于FBSE-ED时频图像表示和轻量级CNN的深度学习方法，用于预测rTMS抑郁症治疗结果，在私有数据集上达到93.60%的分类准确率，优于DWT及其他复杂深度学习模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: rTMS是治疗重度抑郁症(MDD)的非侵入性疗法，但需要一种能够早期预测治疗反应的方法，以便进行更精准的临床决策，避免无效治疗。

Method: 使用FBSE-ED和DWT两种时频方法将EEG信号转换为图像表示，提出轻量级自定义CNN分类器，采用10折交叉验证在私有rTMS数据库上训练，并在另一个私有数据库上测试鲁棒性。

Result: FBSE-ED表示达到93.60%最高分类准确率；优于DWT；比EEGNet、DeepConvNet等EEG专用模型高3.62-10.72%；比Xception等预训练模型高23.03-27.35%。

Conclusion: 将高级信号分解与深度学习相结合可以促进rTMS治疗反应的早期预测，支持更精准的临床决策；该框架可解释、计算高效，适合在现实精神病诊所部署。

Abstract: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a non invasive therapy for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). In this study, we generate images using two time frequency methods to represent EEG signals: Fourier-Bessel Series Expansion with Euclidean Distance (FBSE-ED) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). We propose an efficient deep learning classifier to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy. In this study, we use a private rTMS databases to train a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using 10-fold cross validation strategy in order to avoid any bias in our results. The results show that the FBSE-ED representation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 93.60\%, outperforming traditional time-frequency technique (DWT). In addition, the proposed architecture with FBSE-ED image representation technique outperforms more complex EEG-Specific deep learning models (EEGNet, DeepConvNet, SleepEEGNet) by 3.62-10.72% and pretrained models (Xception, DenseNet201, and MobileNetV2) by 23.03-27.35%. For more experiments, we utilize another private rTMS database as test database to show the robustness of the proposed model. Our results suggest that integrating advanced signal decomposition with deep learning can facilitate early prediction of rTMS treatment response and support more targeted clinical decision-making. The proposed framework is interpretable, computationally efficient, and well-suited for deployment in real-world local psychiatric clinics.

</details>


### [282] [LC-SEPLM: long-range contact-supervised adaptation for sequence-only protein representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22777)
*Chen Wang,Boming Kang,Qinghua Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LC-SEPLM通过LoRA和长程残基接触监督改进ESM2蛋白语言模型，在8个下游任务中超越ESM2，尤其在远源同源识别任务上macro-F1提升6.47个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白语言模型虽能学习可迁移序列表示，但其训练目标未显式约束模型学习蛋白质折叠后形成的三维残基接触信息，限制了模型对结构信息的捕捉能力。

Method: 在ESM2基础上引入LoRA微调，并添加长程残基对接触监督信号；通过配对特异性查询（pair-specific queries）对完整序列进行交叉注意力计算，提取与长程空间接触相关的全局序列上下文；使用500,000个AlphaFold Swiss-Prot蛋白进行训练。

Result: 在全部8个蛋白质级别任务上超越ESM2；远源同源识别任务macro-F1从0.6122提升至0.6769（+6.47%）；在ESM-S EC基准上最大绝对增益达0.1771。

Conclusion: 残基对接触监督是一种有界的、有效的引入结构信息到蛋白序列表示的方法，同时保持序列-only的推理范式。

Abstract: Protein language models learn transferable sequence representations. However, because they primarily model contextual dependencies along amino-acid sequences, their training objectives do not explicitly constrain the model to learn three-dimensional residue contacts formed after folding . Here, we introduce LC-SEPLM (Long-range Contact-supervised ESM Protein Language Model), which adapts ESM2 with LoRA and long-range residue-pair contact supervision while retaining sequence-only downstream inference. Pair-specific queries use cross-attention over the complete sequence to extract global sequence context associated with long-range spatial contacts. To expose the model to diverse structural information, we trained LC-SEPLM on 500,000 AlphaFold Swiss-Prot proteins. In downstream evaluation, LC-SEPLM improved all eight protein-level tasks relative to ESM2. The largest gain occurred in remote-homology recognition, where macro-F1 increased from 0.6122 to 0.6769 (+0.0647, or 6.47 percentage points). On the official ESM-S EC benchmark, LC-SEPLM also outperformed ESM-S with a maximum absolute gain of 0.1771. These results support residue-pair contact supervision as a bounded route for introducing structural information into protein sequence representations while preserving sequence-only inference.

</details>


### [283] [Multimodal Surface EMG Hand Gesture Recognition Using Query-Based Transformers for Prosthetic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22779)
*Federico Del Pup,Elisa Tentori,Manfredo Atzori*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EMG-CrossFormer，一种混合卷积-Transformer架构，用于融合多模态生理信号（sEMG、惯性、眼动）进行手势识别，在NinaPro数据集上显著提升了识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习手势识别方法存在两个问题：1) 纯卷积架构难以捕获长程时序依赖；2) 单模态设置无法利用多模态互补信息（如惯性、眼动数据），导致手势类别增加时性能下降。

Method: 提出EMG-CrossFormer端到端混合卷积-Transformer架构：包含多个单模态编码器，通过级联交叉注意力融合层整合任意数量的模态表示，并使用可学习手势查询解码融合特征。

Result: 在NinaPro四个数据集上，仅用sEMG达到72.33%-79.16%准确率；融合惯性信号后提升至80.40%-92.79%，显著优于六个基线模型。

Conclusion: 联合局部-全局特征建模能改进纯sEMG解码性能，多模态融合进一步放大这一优势，表明这两个设计原则对复杂手势识别至关重要。

Abstract: Hand gesture recognition via surface electromyography (sEMG) is fundamental to prosthetic control. In this field, deep learning approaches have become the gold standard. However, current architectures struggle to scale; model performance typically decreases as the number of hand movements increases. Performance degradation is tied to the increased statistical complexity of decoding expanded gesture sets and compounded by the limitations of state-of-the-art methods, which primarily rely on low-latency unimodal convolutional architectures. Convolutions operate locally, limiting model's ability to capture long-range sequential patterns. Unimodal setups cannot leverage complementary information from coordinated signals characterizing movement execution, such as inertial and eye-tracking data. These limitations motivate architectures that integrate local and global features across multimodal physiological sequences. To bridge this gap, this study introduces EMG-CrossFormer, an end-to-end hybrid convolutional-transformer for seamless multimodal integration. EMG-CrossFormer combines representations from an arbitrary number of unimodal encoders through cascaded cross-attention fusion layers, and decodes the fused representations using learnable gesture queries. EMG-CrossFormer was evaluated on four NinaPro datasets (DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10) and benchmarked against six state-of-the-art models using an increasing number of modalities. Using only sEMG, EMG-CrossFormer achieved mean accuracies of 72.33%, 52.48%, 79.16%, and 73.49% on DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10, respectively. Incorporating inertial signals improved performance to 90.66%, 80.40%, 92.79%, and 92.06%. These results show that joint local-global feature modeling improves sEMG-only decoding and that multimodal fusion substantially amplifies this benefit, underscoring the value of both design principles for complex hand gesture recognition.

</details>


### [284] [What Softmax Throws Away: Mass-Aware Attention for Evidence Accumulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22781)
*Minwoo Yu,Young-guk Ha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Mass-Aware Attention (MAA)，通过对标准注意力机制中L1归一化泛化为Lp族，使重复输入时分子分母不同比例缩放，从而保留结构信息。在多个图模型和时序任务上，MAA在提升任务性能的同时显著改善了隐藏表示中结构信息的可恢复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准注意力机制在重复证据模式时产生"重复不变性"——分子分母同步增长导致不同累积证据量的输入产生相同聚合结果，使模型内部表示丢失预测相关的结构信息（如基本图统计量）。

Method: 将标准L1归一化推广到Lp族，使重复模式下分子与分母以不同速率缩放，从而在表示幅度中保留有效参与输入的数量信息。p=1时退化为标准注意力，不增加监督、参数、隐藏维度或显式计数特征。

Result: 在4个连续时间动态图模型×3个数据集上，11/12个单元的未来链接AUC提升；线性可恢复性平均提高4.49%，偏好连接恢复在所有12个单元中改善。在MTPP、TKG、RAG、STPP等任务中均观察到一致性证据。

Conclusion: 信息可访问性与任务效用是分离的（如RAG中额外信息未改善诊断头，STPP中LayerNorm可能擦除信号）。MAA作为一种通用的归一化原则，通过控制标准注意力中的重复不变性，提升面向预测器的表示信息量。
