In this work, we propose a topology-guided framework for privacy-aware split learning based on the persistent Betti complexity of smashed activations. Through comprehensive layer-wise analysis, we show that privacy risk in split learning is highly non-uniform across layers and exhibits sharp transition regions that are not captured by architectural depth alone. In particular, feature inversion fidelity increases from negligible reconstruction to as high as 0.98 SSIM at deeper, privacy-critical split points. We further demonstrate that Betti complexity consistently identifies representation regimes associated with elevated feature-space privacy leakage across architectures and datasets. Leveraging this observation, we introduce BettiSafe, a topology-guided split selection strategy that identifies privacy-sensitive layers without requiring explicit attack execution. BettiSafe improves resistance to feature inversion by 2 to 5 times compared to depth-based heuristics while preserving classification accuracy. In addition, Betti-based regularisation increases inversion difficulty by nearly 5 x without degrading model utility, enabling a favourable privacy utility tradeoff. Overall, our results highlight topological complexity as a promising structural descriptor for secure, adaptive, and representation-aware split learning in real-world collaborative systems

</details>


### [431] [Bit-Accurate FPGA Evaluation of Learned Feature Gating in a Fixed-Point Fourier-Feature Automatic Modulation Classifier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24568)
*Gawthaman Senthilvelan,Luthira Abeykoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在FPGA上实现自适应调制分类时，学习特征重加权（门控）相比未门控模型，并未提升分类精度，反而增加了硬件资源消耗（ALM、寄存器、DSP和延迟）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件中学习特征重加权可改善AMC，但在FPGA上会增加计算和延迟，作者希望量化这一权衡。

Method: 在紧凑型定点分类器基础上，插入一个32元素、8比特、输入相关的门控层，使用PTQ和QAT训练，在Intel Cyclone V FPGA上独立编译并评估352,000次物理板级分类。

Result: 未门控模型在所有四组对比中均获得更高测试精度，门控导致平均精度下降0.784%（PTQ）和0.616%（QAT）；硬件上门控增加1,318 ALM、1,557寄存器、4 DSP和3,140周期。

Conclusion: 对于该特征表示和实现，学习门控增加了FPGA成本但未提升分类精度，建议在类似场景下谨慎采用此类机制。

Abstract: Learned feature reweighting can improve automatic modulation classification (AMC) in software, but the same operation introduces additional arithmetic and latency when implemented on an FPGA. This work measures that trade-off in a compact fixed-point classifier using 24 sparse DFT-energy features, 8 phase/statistical features, and a 32-to-128-to-11 multilayer perceptron. A second architecture inserts a learned 32-element, 8-bit, input-dependent gate before the classifier. Gated and ungated models are trained using post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) with two matched training seeds. The resulting eight checkpoints are compiled independently for an Intel Cyclone V FPGA and evaluated over 352,000 physical-board classifications. Ungated models achieve higher test accuracy in all four matched gate comparisons, with mean gated-minus-ungated differences of -0.784 percentage points under PTQ and -0.616 percentage points under QAT. The effect of QAT changes direction between the two training seeds. In hardware, the gate adds an average of 1,318 adaptive logic modules (ALMs), 1,557 registers, 4 DSP blocks, and 3,140 processing cycles. All 352,000 board predictions agree exactly with an independent integer reference, and 3,760 captured intermediate values from one training seed also match. For this feature representation and implementation, learned gating increases FPGA cost without improving classification accuracy.

</details>


### [432] [Evaluating Fuzz Testing for Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24577)
*Zhibin Kang,Hanmo You,Dong Wang,Haiming Zheng,Junjie Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对强化学习(RL)智能体模糊测试方法进行了全面的实证研究，从有效性、多样性、效率和实用性四个角度系统评估了五种先进方法，发现MDPFuzz等面向吞吐量的方法在发现崩溃方面效果最佳，而SeqDivFuzz等鼓励探索的方法在揭露多样化崩溃行为上表现突出，并验证了模糊测试生成的崩溃可用于提升智能体鲁棒性和安全监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL智能体在安全关键领域（如机器人、自动驾驶）中部署日益增多，其意外行为可能导致严重后果。尽管已有多种RL模糊测试方法被提出，但现有研究在评估设置、基线和指标上差异较大，难以得出关于其相对有效性和实用性的可靠结论。

Method: 首次进行全面的实证研究，从有效性、多样性、效率和实用性四个互补角度系统评估RL模糊测试方法。在统一配置下，在三个复杂度递增的环境（MountainCar、BipedalWalker、CARLA）中对五种最先进方法与随机测试进行基准比较，并评估检测到的崩溃对智能体鲁棒性提升和安全监控的下游实用性。

Result: MDPFuzz等面向吞吐量的方法在崩溃发现的有效性和效率上表现优越；SeqDivFuzz等明确鼓励探索的方法在揭露多样化崩溃行为方面表现出色；模糊测试生成的崩溃能够有效提升智能体鲁棒性并实现准确的安全监控，且具有良好的跨方法泛化能力。

Conclusion: 为研究人员和实践者提供了可操作的指导建议，强调结合互补的模糊测试策略和采用多层面多样性分析，以实现更全面和实用的RL测试。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains such as robotics, autonomous driving, and drone control, where unexpected behaviors may lead to severe real-world consequences. Fuzz testing has recently emerged as a promising method for exploring the vast state spaces of RL agents and exposing crashes. Although numerous RL fuzzing methods have been proposed, existing studies often differ in evaluation settings, baselines, and metrics, making it difficult to draw reliable conclusions about their relative effectiveness and practical usefulness. To address this gap, we present the first comprehensive empirical study that systematically evaluates RL fuzzing methods from four complementary perspectives: effectiveness, diversity, efficiency, and practical utility. We benchmark five state-of-the-art methods alongside random testing under unified configurations across three environments of increasing complexity (MountainCar, BipedalWalker, and CARLA), and further assess the downstream usefulness of detected crashes for agent robustness improvement and safety monitoring. Our results reveal several key insights. For instance,throughput-oriented methods like MDPFuzz demonstrate superior effectiveness and efficiency in crash discovery, while methods explicitly designed to encourage exploration like SeqDivFuzz excel at uncovering diverse crash behaviors. We also show that fuzzing-generated crashes can meaningfully improve agent robustness and enable accurate safety monitoring with strong cross-method generalization. Beyond these empirical findings, we distill actionable guidance for both researchers and practitioners, highlighting the benefits of combining complementary fuzzing strategies and adopting multi-level diversity analysis to achieve more comprehensive and practical RL testing.

</details>


### [433] [PYPM-GGD: Pitman-Yor Process Mixture with Generalized Gaussian Density using ADAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24583)
*Kart-Leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于自适应步长随机梯度上升的非共轭变分推断方法，用于大规模贝叶斯非参数学习，克服了传统SVI对共轭后验和衰减步长的依赖，在MIT67和SUN397等大规模数据集上取得了与深度聚类方法相当或更优的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SVI等大规模BNP方法依赖共轭变分后验假设，无法处理非共轭后验的大规模学习问题。现有非共轭方法依赖蒙特卡洛近似，计算复杂且多用于逻辑回归等简单模型，难以扩展到复杂BNP任务。

Method: 基于常数步长随机梯度上升，不要求变分后验期望的闭式解，仅需变分后验可微。借鉴SVI和Adam的思想，引入了自适应步长策略来加速收敛。

Result: 与ResNet特征兼容，在MIT67和SUN397等大类别数数据集上有效。与深度聚类等现有方法相比，在聚类指标上达到或超越了最先进水平。

Conclusion: 所提出的自适应步长非共轭变分推断方法成功解决了大规模非共轭后验学习难题，为BNP在大规模复杂数据集上的应用提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Large scale Bayesian nonparametrics (BNP) learner such as Stochastic Variational Inference (SVI) can handle datasets with large class number and large training size at fractional cost. Like its predecessor, SVI rely on the assumption of conjugate variational posterior to approximate the true posterior. A more challenging problem is to consider large scale learning on non-conjugate posterior. Recent works in this direction are mostly associated with using Monte Carlo methods for approximating the learner. However, these works are usually demonstrated on non-BNP related task and less complex models such as logistic regression, due to higher computational complexity. In order to overcome the issue faced by SVI, we develop a novel approach based on the recently proposed constant stepsize stochastic gradient ascent to allow large scale learning on non-conjugate posterior. Unlike SVI, our new learner does not require closed- form expression for the variational posterior expectatations. Our only requirement is that the variational posterior is differentiable. In order to ensure convergence in stochastic settings, SVI rely on decaying step-sizes to slow its learning. Inspired by SVI and Adam, we propose the novel use of adaptive stepsizes in our method to significantly improve its learning. We show that our proposed methods is compatible with ResNet features when applied to large class number datasets such as MIT67 and SUN397. Finally, we compare our proposed learner with several recent works such as deep clustering algorithms and showed we were able to produce on-par or outperform the state-of-the-art methods in terms of clustering measures.

</details>


### [434] [Attribution and Uncertainty Behavior of Learned Residual Gyro Correction for Gyro-Stellar Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24608)
*Mariela De Lucas Álvarez,Melvin Laux,Arthur de Freitas Precht,Maurice Martin,Edoardo Caroselli,Frank Kirchner,Alexander Fabisch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于深度学习的陀螺仪偏差校正框架中的不确定性分解与可解释性。1D-CNN网络从多传感器输入预测角速率修正，同时输出异方差偶然不确定性和认知不确定性（通过集成模型估计）。在名义和扰动条件下评估，发现认知不确定性更能有效区分正常与异常工况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于学习的导航/姿态估计系统中，不确定性量化对于系统可靠性至关重要，但现有工作缺乏对混合学习型状态估计组件中不同类型不确定性的深入分析和可解释性研究。

Method: 使用1D-CNN从陀螺仪和星敏感器输入预测陀螺仪偏差修正；异方差偶然不确定性直接由网络输出，认知不确定性通过集成多个独立训练的模型估计；采用基于梯度的归因方法对修正和不确定性输出进行解释分析。

Result: 偶然不确定性随扰动强度增加而增大，但分布重叠且标定跨工况不一致；认知不确定性在分布偏移时给出清晰信号，模型间分歧增大，更善于区分名义工况和被扰动工况。

Conclusion: 偶然不确定性和认知不确定性具有良好的协作性，认知不确定性是区分正常与异常工况的更优指标，可用于下游监控和故障检测。

Abstract: This work investigates uncertainty decomposition and explainability in a deep learning-based framework for gyroscope bias correction. A 1-D Convolutional Neural Network is trained to predict residual angular rate corrections from multi-sensor inputs, including gyroscope and star tracker measurements. The bias corrections are sent to a flight-representative Gyro-Stellar Estimator. The network produces both mean corrections and input-dependent (heteroscedastic) aleatoric uncertainty, while epistemic uncertainty is estimated via an ensemble of independently trained models.
  The proposed approach is trained under nominal conditions and evaluated in both nominal and structured perturbations that include additive and temporally correlated noise. Gradient-based attribution methods are applied to both the correction and uncertainty outputs, enabling a decomposition of the evidence that drives state updates and uncertainty estimates. By aggregating attribution patterns across rotational axes and regimes, we reveal axis-specific behaviors and characterize how structured perturbations influence the collaboration between aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty.
  Uncertainty analysis shows that aleatoric uncertainty increases with perturbation intensity, but the distributions overlap and the calibration is not consistent across regimes. On the other hand, epistemic uncertainty gives a clear signal that gets clearer as the distributional shift happens, showing that the models disagree more. These results show that aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty work well together and that epistemic uncertainty is better at distinguishing between nominal and perturbed operating conditions. The results provide insight into the behavior of hybrid learning-based state estimation components and motivate the use of uncertainty for downstream monitoring and fault detection.

</details>


### [435] [When Can You Correct Distribution Drift in Temporal Graph Generation? A Sharpening--Drift Tension and an Impossibility for Observation-Based Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24662)
*Tianpeng Li,Xuan Guo,Wenjun Wang,Wang Zhang,Pengfei Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了时序图生成模型在训练集与部署集之间存在不可修复的退化现象，证明了该退化源自不可约熵与训练中罕见结构的散度，且经验上呈幂律关系。尽管部署期可观测，但基于过去观测的校正器无法有效降低误差，趋势外推甚至比不做任何处理更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序图生成模型在从训练期迁移到部署期时性能显著下降，作者希望揭示这种现象的本质、普遍性及可修复性。

Method: 通过理论推导（掩码流匹配损失的精确分解）、经验分析（幂律标度）和可校正性证明（条件方差下界、趋势外推条件），结合大量实验验证。

Result: 退化幂律指数为-0.605（R²=0.9977）；漂移将误差基底提高2.2倍至34.3倍，但采样预算变化对误差影响不超过6%；最优观测校正器仅恢复5.7%的理论可消除误差，趋势外推劣于不做任何操作。

Conclusion: 时序图模型的部署退化是本质的、无法通过观测修复的，传统校正策略失效，需要根本性的建模范式转变。

Abstract: Generative models of temporal graphs are trained on one stretch of an evolving network and deployed on the next, and they degrade badly in the gap. We show this degradation is derivable, general, and not fixable from observations. The masked flow-matching loss decomposes exactly, with no independence assumption, into an irreducible entropy plus a divergence whose derivative along the training path is positive precisely for structures rare during training and common at deployment, diverging as their training probability goes to zero. Empirically the trade-off is a power law with exponent $-0.605$ ($R^2=0.9977$), and drift raises the sampler's error floor without changing how many steps reach it: across seven well-powered conditions the drift-period marginal error varies by at most $6\%$ over a $50\times$ range of sampling budgets, while the floor sits $2.2\times$ to $34.3\times$ above the in-period floor. Because the deployment period is observed, correction looks like a matter of measurement. It is not. We prove that any corrector measurable with respect to past observations leaves at least the conditional variance of the statistic it tracks, and that trend extrapolation beats trusting the last observation only when $μ^2>v(1-2ρ)$. Both premises are measurable and both go the wrong way: the drift is trendless and mean-reverting, with a one-step innovation as large as the drift itself. An oracle removes $60\%$ of the error, the best observation-based corrector recovers $5.7\%$ of that, and extrapolation is strictly worse than doing nothing clever.

</details>


### [436] [Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24672)
*Shaker Al-Tamari,Waled Kadour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过策略蒸馏框架，将高性能连续控制DRL模型（TD3）的知识迁移至可解释的浅层决策树中，在倒立摆基准上实现了性能等价，并揭示了连续控制向离散规则控制转换时产生的高频Bang-Bang驱动与稳定双模极限环现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRL在安全关键领域（如机器人、汽车工程）部署受限于深度神经网络的黑箱特性，导致监管合规困难且人机信任不足，亟需提升可解释性。

Method: 采用策略蒸馏框架：以高性能TD3作为连续教师模型，将其策略蒸馏至基于浅层决策树的解释性学生代理；引入物理感知特征和"噪声Oracle回滚"生成数据集。

Result: 蒸馏后的决策树模型达到了与教师模型相当的性能；从连续控制转向离散规则控制引发高频Bang-Bang驱动和稳定的双模极限环；BIBO稳定性得以维持。

Conclusion: 通过策略蒸馏可在保持性能的同时实现全局与局部可解释性，但存在连续到离散控制转换带来的非线性动力学权衡，为安全自主系统的可解释部署提供了理论与实验依据。

Abstract: In safety-critical sectors such as robotics and automotive engineering, the deployment of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is often hindered by the black-box nature of deep neural networks. This lack of transparency poses significant challenges for regulatory compliance and human-agent trust. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at making high-performance continuous control DRL systems interpretable. A policy distillation framework is implemented using the classic Inverted Pendulum benchmark. A high-performance Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3) agent serves as an opaque, continuous teacher model, whose policy is distilled into an interpretable student surrogate based on a shallow Decision Tree. By leveraging a custom physics-aware feature and "Noisy Oracle Rollouts" for dataset generation, the distillation process achieves performance equivalent to the expert teacher. Furthermore, comparative control theory analysis reveals a fundamental trade-off: transitioning from continuous to discrete rule-based control induces high-frequency Bang-Bang actuation and a stable bimodal limit cycle. Simulation results indicate that Bounded-Input Bounded-Output (BIBO) stability is maintained while providing both global and local interpretability for safe autonomous systems.

</details>


### [437] [Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24673)
*Mohammad Fesanghary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Causal-TS 是一个开源 Python 库，专门用于高维非平稳多元时间序列的因果发现，提供多种算法、GPU 加速、结构断点检测、命令行接口和端到端因果效应估计流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果发现工具在高维、非平稳场景下适用性不足，缺乏统一框架和 GPU 加速支持，难以处理结构突变等实际问题。

Method: 提供四种专用算法（CDNOTS、CDNOTS+、CEDAR、GRACE）及多种经典方法包装器；统一条件独立测试层基于 PyTorch 实现 GPU 加速；采用可插拔变点检测器实现结构断点发现，并按不同状态分别进行因果发现；支持命令行接口和 DoWhy 集成。

Result: 构建了可通过 pip 安装的完整工具库，支持 Python 3.10-3.12，已在 GitHub 开源。

Conclusion: Causal-TS 为高维非平稳时间序列因果发现提供了统一、可扩展且高效的端到端解决方案。

Abstract: We describe Causal-TS, an open-source Python library for causal discovery in high-dimensional and nonstationary multivariate time series. Causal-TS provides four specialized algorithms-CDNOTS, CDNOTS+, CEDAR, and GRACE-along with wrappers for GES, Granger, LASSO-VAR, and LGES, all sharing a unified conditional independence (CI) test layer with GPU acceleration via PyTorch. A regime discovery pipeline detects structural breaks via pluggable changepoint detectors and runs discovery per regime with regime-specific parameters. A command-line interface, synthetic data generators, and optional DoWhy integration provide an end-to-end pipeline from raw time series to causal effect estimates. The library is pip-installable, tested on Python 3.10--3.12, and available at https://github.com/bloomberg/causal-ts.

</details>


### [438] [Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24726)
*Justin Sirignano,Konstantinos Spiliopoulos,Samuel Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了对于一类半线性偏微分方程，使用梯度下降法最小化PDE残差目标函数的神经网络（如DGM和PINNs）会收敛到PDE的解，为该类方法的理论基础提供了重要支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决DGM和PINNs方法中因目标函数非凸性导致神经网络可能仅收敛到局部最优而非PDE解的理论质疑，需要建立这类算法收敛到PDE解的数学基础。

Method: 针对一类半线性PDE（解及其一阶导数为非线性），从理论上证明通过梯度下降训练最小化PDE残差目标函数的神经网络会收敛到PDE的真实解。

Result: 成功证明了对于所考虑的半线性PDE类别，神经网络训练能够收敛到PDE解。

Conclusion: 为DGM和PINNs方法的数学基础提供了理论保证，表明在这些条件下神经网络不会陷入非PDE解的局部最优。

Abstract: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific machine learning. In these methods, a neural network is trained to approximate the PDE solution by using (stochastic) gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual of the neural network. Due to the non-convexity of the PDE residual objective function, the trained neural network may, in principle, only converge to a local minimizer of the objective function (which would not be a solution of the PDE). Therefore, there is a longstanding question regarding the mathematical foundations of these algorithms, and it is highly valuable to establish that the trained neural network will converge to the PDE solution. For a class of semi-linear PDEs (nonlinear in the solution and its first derivative), we prove that neural networks trained with gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual objective function will converge to the PDE solution.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [439] [Spectral Dynamics of Semantic Drift in Clinical Multi-Agent Language Model Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22758)
*Amritesh Banerjee*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文证明在多智能体诊断框架中，Barabási–Albert和Watts–Strogatz等无标度/小世界网络拓扑会导致语义溃散：余弦相似度下降53.29%，方差放大51.81%，熵达饱和阈值H∞≈5.947。作者提出基于图拉普拉斯代数连通性（λ₂_min）的动态谱监测方法（O(N³)）来确保全局状态扩散，认为拓扑稳定性是自主医疗诊断的不可妥协的定量要务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体诊断框架普遍假设无标度或小世界网络具有最优通信效率，但该假设未经严格定量检验。作者旨在数学上推翻这一假设，揭示语义数据下结构瓶颈对诊断安全性的损害。

Method: 将多智能体通信不确定性轨迹映射到768维Bio_ClinicalBERT嵌入空间，以各向同性方差代理为分析工具，在BA和WS网络上构建相变矩阵；引入动态谱监测，通过图拉普拉斯的连续特征分解施加代数连通性下界（λ₂_min），保证全局状态扩散。

Result: BA/WS网络导致：余弦相似度退化53.29%；方差放大51.81%（ρ=1.5181），远高于ER随机图（ρ=1.0766）；熵固定饱和于H∞≈5.947。高聚类架构使局部幻觉自主复合，无法达成全局共识。

Conclusion: 自治医疗诊断的可靠性必须以拓扑稳定性为定量底线。基于谱监测的拓扑约束（O(N³)）是保障安全性的必要手段，hub中心化架构在语义数据下适得其反。

Abstract: The integration of iterative LLMs within multi-agent diagnostic frameworks requires a rigorous quantitative reevaluation of underlying communication topologies. Frequently used architectural paradigms depend on scale-free or small-world networks, assuming optimal communication efficiency. Our study mathematically dismantles that assumption for semantic data. By mapping multi-agent communication uncertainty trajectories onto a 768-dimensional Bio_ClinicalBERT embedding space via an analytical isotropic variance proxy using Barab'asi--Albert (BA) and Watts--Strogatz (WS) networks, we prove that structural bottlenecks compromise diagnostic safety. Our phase transition matrices illustrate that localized dense cliques confine hallucinated data, preventing global consensus and forcing the system toward a permanent entropy saturation threshold of $H_{\infty} \approx 5.947$. As a result, we measure a severe terminal cosine similarity degradation of 53.29%, completely overwriting the original ground-truth. Moreover, the terminal semantic drift reveals a catastrophic variance amplification of 51.81% ($ρ= 1.5181$) in highly clustered architectures, proving total system unpredictability when compared to Erdős--R'enyi configurations ($ρ= 1.0766$). Instead of reducing errors, hub-centric systems autonomously compound localized hallucinations. By introducing dynamic spectral monitoring operating at an $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ time complexity and imposing a strict lower bound on algebraic connectivity ($λ_{2_{min}}$) via the continuous eigen-decomposition of the graph Laplacian, we present a mathematically rigorous technique to ensure global state diffusion. Securing the reliability of autonomous medical diagnostics necessitates treating topological stability as a non-negotiable quantitative imperative.

</details>


### [440] [Emergent Behaviour in Financial Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23311)
*Omar Inverso,Emilio Tuosto,Dragisa Zunic*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文探讨了复杂系统中涌现行为的自动化推理挑战，以电子金融市场为例，识别并结构化复杂性的来源，并提出一个系统的研究计划，用于市场机制的形式化规约与分析，同时避免对具体技术方案的偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化方法社区逐渐意识到需要向其他学科开放，以提供计算机辅助推理技术来理解复杂系统中的涌现行为，但目前缺乏系统性的方法论来应对自动化推理面临的独特挑战。

Method: 以电子金融市场为驱动案例，识别并结构化复杂性的来源，讨论处理自动化分析中主要技术方面的多种可能方案，同时保持对领域的坚实具体解释，从而勾勒出系统的研究计划。

Result: 提出了一个用于形式化规约与分析市场机制的系统性研究计划，指出了处理复杂性来源的多种可行技术路径，但未对具体方案做优劣评判。

Conclusion: 未来的研究工作应围绕形式化规约与分析市场机制展开系统性研究，在避免简化假设的前提下，探索处理自动化分析中技术难题的多种替代方案。

Abstract: Some properties of so-called complex or collective systems can be observed to emerge from the interactions of elementary agents. This phenomenon, known as emergent behaviour, has long since been studied in the most diverse disciplines, with recent growing awareness from the formal methods community about the opportunity of opening up to seemingly distant disciplines with appropriate technology for computer-aided reasoning. Different peculiar elements of complexity make automated reasoning on these systems particularly challenging. We consider electronic financial markets to drive our discussion. We identify and structure the sources of complexity to tackle in order to provide computational support for the analysis of emergent phenomena. We refrain from evaluating the suitability of specific technical solutions or frameworks of preference, which would as usual require simplifying assumptions and divert from the actual phenomenon of interest. Rather, we elaborate on possible alternatives to handle some of the main technical aspects involved in automated analysis, while retaining a solid and concrete interpretation of the domain, and in doing so outline a more systematic research program for the formal specification and analysis of market mechanisms.

</details>


### [441] [MulRobBench: A Decision-Level Benchmark for Safe and Security-Policy-Compliant Multimodal UAV Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23870)
*Belal S. Alsinglawi,Weizheng Wang,Junyi Wu,Yi Jiang,Lianhai Lin,Merouane Debbah,Izzat Alsmadi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出了MulRobBench，一个针对城市低空环境中VLA无人机智能体的离线、协议条件化基准测试，涵盖17个任务节点、12个评分维度，评估17个多模态模型，最高语义协议决策得分仅0.5141，揭示多模态决策不稳定性的关键原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UAV和多模态基准主要评估感知、导航、协作和推理，但缺乏在关键决策中评估物理证据、协议约束和行动风险三者耦合能力的基准。

Method: 集成真实UAV多模态观测、协议级安全策略和动作级网络物理安全，构建统一评估框架；包含3,024个样本、17个任务分类节点、12个评分维度，覆盖四个评估阶段；结合语义评分和结构化诊断。

Result: 最佳语义协议决策得分仅0.5141，最佳严格平均评分维度准确率为0.1599；20锚点模态消融实验显示每模型改变4-15个行动选择；识别出模态信任选择、约束提取、眩光、缺失数据和操作员简写为主要决策不稳定原因。

Conclusion: MulRobBench提供了可复现的基准测试，用于评估城市低空环境中可信赖的多模态UAV决策，揭示当前模型在协议约束下决策的严重不足。

Abstract: Smart-city airspace is transforming Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from passive sensing platforms into cyber-physical decision makers that must follow operational rules under degraded observations and ambiguous language. Existing UAV and multimodal benchmarks evaluate perception, navigation, collaboration, and reasoning, but few assess whether physical evidence, protocol constraints, and action risk remain coupled during critical decisions. We introduce MulRobBench, an offline, protocol-conditioned benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) UAV agents in smart-city environments. MulRobBench integrates real UAV multimodal observations, protocol-level security policies, and action-level cyber-physical safety into a unified evaluation framework. The benchmark contains 3,024 samples spanning 17 task taxonomy nodes and 12 scoring dimensions across four stages: operational context understanding, multimodal evidence arbitration, degradation-aware reasoning, and risk-aware action planning. Evaluation combines semantic scoring with structural diagnostics, including policy compliance, format compliance, unsafe actions, parsing failures, and dimension-level validity. Across 17 multimodal models, the best semantic protocol-decision score reaches only 0.5141, while the best strict mean scoring-dimension accuracy is 0.1599. A controlled 20-anchor modality-ablation study changes 4-15 action selections per model, confirming that both visual and textual inputs influence decisions. Analysis identifies modality-trust selection, constraint extraction, glare, missing data, and operator shorthand as the primary causes of decision instability. MulRobBench provides a reproducible benchmark for trustworthy multimodal UAV decision making under realistic operational constraints.

</details>


### [442] [A Comparative Study of MCP and A2A for Inter-Agent Coordination in LLM-Based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23884)
*Ionut Predoaia,Tuong Manh Vu,Konstantinos Barmpis,Dimitris Kolovos,Antonio García-Domínguez*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文对MCP和A2A两种智能体通信协议进行了实现层面的比较，发现MCP在受限系统中更轻量简单但需显式处理状态管理，而A2A原生支持复杂协调但实现复杂度更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于LLM和工具的智能体系统在工业实践中迅速涌现，智能体间的协调和协议设计成为实际问题，但缺乏对不同协议在工程实现层面的系统比较。

Method: 作者从多智能体系统工程视角，对MCP和A2A协议进行实现层面的对比，使用同一软件工程任务分别在两种协议下构建智能体系统，基于文献和行业伙伴需求（如可发现性、多部分消息、多轮对话、异步通信、可观测性、互操作性、访问控制）进行评估。

Result: MCP能以更轻量级实现模型支持受限LLM系统中的智能体协调，协调复杂度低，但对话状态管理和任务生命周期处理需在应用层显式实现；A2A通过协议级抽象原生支持有状态、多轮协调，但实现和协调复杂度显著更高。

Conclusion: 由于评估范围有限，这些发现作为设计观察而非普适性结论，强调了协议抽象如何影响当代智能体系统中协调责任的分布。

Abstract: Recent industry practice has seen the rapid emergence of agentic systems composed of heterogeneous, tool- and LLM-mediated agent components, raising practical questions about inter-agent coordination and protocol design. This paper presents an implementation-grounded comparison of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, from a multi-agent systems engineering perspective, using an inter-agent coordination scenario involving LLM-based agents. We evaluate an MCP-based and an A2A-based multi-agent implementation of the same software engineering task against a set of requirements derived from prior literature and discussions with industry partners, including agent discoverability, multi-part messaging, multi-turn conversations, asynchronous communication, observability, interoperability, and access control. The results evidence that MCP can support inter-agent coordination in constrained LLM-based systems through a comparatively lightweight implementation model with lower coordination complexity, although coordination concerns such as conversational state management and task lifecycle handling must be implemented explicitly at the application layer. In contrast, A2A provides richer native support for stateful, multi-turn coordination through protocol-level abstractions for tasks and lifecycle management, but this comes with substantially greater implementation and coordination complexity. Given the narrow scope of the evaluated coordination pattern, these findings are presented as design observations from an empirical experience report rather than general claims of protocol suitability or superiority across broader classes of MAS, highlighting trade-offs and how protocol abstractions shape the distribution of coordination responsibilities in contemporary agentic systems.

</details>


### [443] [Moral Hazard in Multi-Agent Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23982)
*Dane Malenfant*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出对话道德风险博弈（Dialogue Moral Hazard Game），用于评估语言模型在隐藏行动结构下的合作行为。研究发现，基础模型常保留本地奖励而不实现团队成功，或查询但不传递有效信息。不同优化方法效果各异，且可能在不恢复预期合作机制的情况下提升整体奖励，因此需要基于机制层面而非仅团队成功来评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当社会价值努力成本高昂、弱可观测且主要惠及他人时，合作可能失败。作者希望将Holmström的团队道德风险模型引入语言智能体评估，以揭示在隐藏行动结构下模型是否真正学习到了合作机制。

Method: 基于Holmström团队道德风险模型，设计了对话道德风险博弈（Dialogue Moral Hazard Game），其中智能体可选择保存即时本地奖励或支付查询成本以揭示隐藏的安全事实。评估了7个开源语言模型，并使用监督微调、RLOO、顺序SFT+RLOO、GEPA提示优化作为诊断性更新机制。

Result: 基础模型常见行为是保留本地奖励而不实现团队成功，或进行查询但不传递能改变最终决策的信息。不同优化方法效果异质：OLMo-7B在权重层面表现出最清晰的机制一致性改进，而GEPA有时在减少或消除昂贵查询的同时提升团队成功。

Conclusion: 优化可以在不恢复预期合作机制的情况下改变整体奖励，这激励了在评估中报告机制层面行为而非仅报告团队成功。

Abstract: Cooperation can fail when socially valuable effort is costly, weakly observable, and mainly benefits others. Drawing on Holmström's team moral-hazard model, we introduce the Dialogue Moral Hazard Game, a controlled textual game that operationalizes this hidden-action structure for language agents. In each episode, an agent can preserve an immediate local reward or pay a query cost to reveal a hidden safety fact that primarily helps another agent's downstream decision. We evaluate seven open-weight language models and decompose behavior into query use, realized information transfer, local-reward preservation, unsafe choice, format validity, and team success. Base models commonly preserve local reward without team success or query without communicating information that changes the final decision. We then use supervised fine-tuning, RLOO, sequential SFT+RLOO, and GEPA prompt optimization as diagnostic update mechanisms. Their effects are heterogeneous: OLMo-7B shows the clearest mechanism-consistent weight-level improvement, whereas GEPA sometimes improves team success while reducing or eliminating costly queries. Thus, optimization can shift aggregate reward without recovering the intended cooperative mechanism, motivating evaluations that report mechanism-level behavior rather than team success alone.

</details>


### [444] [Decentralised Consensus Learning Networks: SME Rotation Without Centralised Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24416)
*Florin Neagu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 提出了一种去中心化、基于共识的多智能体学习框架，通过同伴验证而非预设奖励产生专业知识，在84次仿真实验中表现出稳定的SME旋转、拓扑不变性和高维信念下的专家集中现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI学习系统依赖中心化奖励信号，将单一的"正确"或"有价值"的知识定义强加于系统，限制了知识涌现的多样性与自发性。

Method: 提出去中心化共识多智能体框架：智能体通过加权社会共识更新信念，基于同伴一致性而非真实值分配信任，动态将排名前百分位的智能体标记为领域专家（SME）。

Result: (1) SME旋转鲁棒、持久、拓扑不变、规模不变，90-100%智能体曾获SME；(2) 向量信念引入异质性收敛和级联动力学；(3) 高维(D=150-200)时网络达到稳定部分共识，专业知识集中于单一智能体。

Conclusion: 高维信念空间中，与集体信念最一致的智能体自然涌现为公认专家，这是去中心化学习的涌现特性，而非随机噪声所致。

Abstract: Centralised reward signals dominate modern AI learning systems, but they impose a single external definition of correct or valuable knowledge. We present a decentralised, consensus-based multi-agent learning framework in which expertise emerges through peer validation rather than prescribed reward. Agents update beliefs via weighted social consensus, while trust is allocated according to competence inferred from peer consistency instead of ground truth. Subject-matter expert (SME) status is assigned dynamically as a top-percentile competence rank rather than a fixed label.
  We evaluate the framework across 84 simulation runs spanning 30 to 10,000 agents, multiple graph topologies, sparse large-scale networks, scalar and vector belief representations, dimensionality sweeps (D=1-500), multi-seed robustness tests, and parameter sensitivity analyses. Phase 1 shows that SME rotation is robust, persistent, topology-invariant, and scale-invariant: 90-100% of agents attain SME status, with most expertise turnover occurring after belief convergence and increasing with network size. Phases 2 and 3 show that vector beliefs introduce heterogeneous convergence with cascade dynamics and reveal five distinct dynamical regimes as belief dimensionality increases. At high dimensionality (D=150-200), the network reaches stable partial consensus while expertise becomes increasingly concentrated in a single agent. ETA sensitivity analysis demonstrates that this concentration is driven by belief dimensionality rather than stochastic noise. We interpret this behaviour as an emergent property of decentralised learning: in complex high-dimensional consensus spaces, the agent most consistently aligned with the collective belief naturally emerges as the recognised expert.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [445] [Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22544)
*Yassine Oueslati,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: C-VCE 提出了一种新的扩散框架，通过概念瓶颈层将分类器直接内置到生成模型中，无需依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器即可生成语义可解释的反事实图像，在 CelebA 等基准上实现了更高的翻转率和更低的图像失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的反事实解释方法依赖外部分类器，但这些分类器在噪声图像上表现不稳定，部署困难，无法提供鲁棒的解释。

Method: 通过概念瓶颈层将分类器整合进扩散模型，用户可在采样时切换语义概念；并加入概率正则化项平衡"改变预测"与"保持原图相似"，以及梯度掩码限制修改区域。

Result: 在 CelebA 等基准上，C-VCE 匹配或提高了翻转率，生成的图像在视觉上更接近输入、失真更少，优于依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器的基线方法。

Conclusion: 暴露并控制内部概念层是使生成模型更易理解、更安全使用的有前景方向，C-VCE 可作为安全关键领域视觉系统的实用工具。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

</details>


### [446] [SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22548)
*Giovanni B. Esposito,Francesco Antici,Daniele Cesarini,Andrea Bartolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SeT-Diff，首个面向计算节点遥测时间序列的基础模型，利用扩散模型和传感器语义描述实现零样本泛化，在重构、插补、预测和虚拟感知任务中表现优异，可作为HPC系统的数据驱动数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HPC机器学习方法依赖静态传感器变量且针对单一任务，当目标任务变化或传感器指标变化时模型失效，缺乏灵活通用的数字孪生模型。

Method: 提出SeT-Diff扩散模型，将生成过程条件化于每个传感器的语义描述，从而解耦系统动态与数据集结构，实现跨传感器配置的泛化能力。

Result: 在真实超算数据集上，重构任务MAE达0.0470；支持零样本置换稳定性；单一预训练模型可有效完成数据插补、预测和虚拟感知（热推断MAE为0.033）。

Conclusion: SeT-Diff是首个面向HPC遥测的基础模型，通过语义条件扩散机制有效解耦系统动态与传感器结构，为计算节点数字孪生提供了灵活、通用的数据驱动方案。

Abstract: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

</details>


### [447] [QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22549)
*Winson Chen,Yuqi Zhang,Sixu Chen,Nuo Xu,Qiang Guan,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了QFoldAgent，一个闭环多智能体框架，用于5残基四面体格点蛋白质折叠。设计智能体提出序列条件惩罚项，VQE量子-经典管道优化哈密顿量，反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号改进惩罚项。在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å；在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%的无效案例被恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合量子-经典蛋白质结构预测方法中，哈密顿量惩罚权重通常由人工固定，且仅在极短片段上进行模拟评估，缺乏系统性的自动化调优机制。

Method: 提出QFoldAgent闭环多智能体框架：①设计智能体提出序列条件惩罚权重；②VQE量子-经典管道在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量；③反馈智能体使用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号迭代改进惩罚项。整个流程不暴露地面真值指标（如RMSD）。

Result: QDockBank基准（55个已知结构片段）：中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，最难目标提升最大。未见序列（100个）：结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%初始无效案例被恢复；最强控制器在87%序列上改善了第三轮能量，同时保持96%的Ramachandran偏好几何。

Conclusion: 迭代智能体控制能够系统性地改善优化行为并减少5残基量子设置下的失败案例，证明闭环多智能体方法在量子-经典蛋白质折叠中具有显著潜力。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.

</details>


### [448] [Lexical discovery in unknown environments orchestrated by Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22591)
*Rafael Sendra-Arranz,Iñaki Dellibarda Varela,Eduardo Rocon,Álvaro Gutiérrez,Manuel Cebrian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出神经符号词汇发现（NSLD）框架，使基于LLM的智能体群体在未知环境中通过参照游戏自主组织共享的外星词汇，并实现高效收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体在未知环境（如行星或深海探索）中需要共享词汇来指代任何人类语言中没有名称的实体，现有方法缺乏自主词汇发现机制。

Method: NSLD框架：每个智能体结合冻结的CLIP视觉编码器、私有FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，通过参照游戏在分布外视觉参照物上自主组织共享的外星词汇，并将发现的外星词通过嵌入空间语义邻近性锚定到自然语言。

Result: 在最多20个智能体和10个视觉参照物的模拟中达成共识，通过三种分析模型刻画收敛动态，R² > 0.95。

Conclusion: 该框架是实现自主探索任务预部署规划的第一步，有效扩展了人类词汇库中感知可锚定的新词。

Abstract: Populations of autonomous agents deployed in unknown environments (e.g. planetary or deep-sea exploration) must develop shared vocabularies to refer to entities that have no name in any human language. We propose the Neuro-Symbolic Lexical Discovery (NSLD) framework, in which a population of LLM-based agents plays a referential game over out-of-distribution visual referents, autonomously self-organising a shared alien lexicon. Each agent combines a frozen CLIP vision encoder with a private FAISS vector index and a text-only LLM. Crucially, discovered alien words are anchored to natural language via semantic proximity in the embedding space, enlarging the human vocabulary with new perceptually grounded words. Consensus is reached in simulations with populations of up to twenty agents and ten visual referents. Convergence dynamics are characterised through three analytical models achieving R^2 > 0.95, representing a first step towards pre-deployment planning in autonomous exploration missions.

</details>


### [449] [Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22554)
*Kazem Faghih,Yize Cheng,Shoumik Saha,Mobina Pournemat,Armin Gerami,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LLMs在基准测试中准确率高，但在语义等价的改写下，实例级回答不稳定，改写导致正误切换率达23%以上。作者提出自我改写策略可部分恢复潜在知识，表明标准准确率掩盖了实质性的不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估LLM在语义等价改写下的回答稳定性，揭示标准单次准确率指标无法反映模型真实可靠性。

Method: 在4个基准测试和13个模型上，对事实问答和数学推理任务施加保义改写，分析输出变化；提出自我改写策略来恢复潜在知识。

Result: 整体准确率变动不大，但实例级正误切换率超23%；原问题正确时改写后翻转率更高；多数问题至少有一个改写版本得到正确答案。

Conclusion: 标准准确率指标掩盖了实质性的不稳定，评估等价输入下的一致性才能更清晰反映LLM的可靠性；自我改写可部分改善性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.

</details>


### [450] [Decentralized Granular Access Control for Agentic AI Systems in Critical Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22611)
*Arun Malik,Deepal Jayasinghe,Bradley Klemick,Prachi Shah,Nitish Talasu,Vineet Tushar Trivedi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向自主AI代理的去中心化多层访问控制架构，解决了传统RBAC模型无法应对AI随机行为导致的安全挑战。该系统在生产环境中部署八个月，处理20+AI代理和60+确定性剧本，实现了零未授权写操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主AI代理在云基础设施中展现出随机行为，传统基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）模型难以应对其安全挑战，现有信任模型不足以约束AI代理对关键系统的访问。

Method: 提出四项关键创新：复合身份模型（将代理行为绑定到人类授权）、五级分层权限系统（从全局平台访问到单参数约束）、去中心化策略所有权模型（工具团队独立管理授权边界）、以及带安全互锁的渐进信任升级机制。

Result: 在大型云提供商的上百个数据中心生产环境中部署八个月，系统管理20+专业AI代理和60+确定性剧本，每天处理数千次操作，实现了零未授权写操作。

Conclusion: 该架构基于OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025)威胁分类法设计，能有效缓解特定攻击向量，并通过分层授权防止非确定性实体的权限提升。

Abstract: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production infrastructure introduces fundamental security challenges that traditional role-based access control (RBAC) models cannot address. Unlike deterministic automation, AI agents exhibit stochastic behavior, making conventional trust models insufficient for governing their access to critical systems. This paper presents a decentralized, multi-layered access control architecture designed specifically for agentic AI systems operating in critical cloud infrastructure. Our framework introduces four key innovations: (1) a compound identity model that binds agent actions to delegated human authority, (2) a hierarchical permission system spanning five granularity levels from global platform access to per-parameter constraints, (3) a decentralized policy ownership model where tool teams independently govern their authorization boundaries, and (4) progressive trust escalation with safety interlocks that prevent autonomous agents from executing high-risk operations. We ground our design in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) threat taxonomy and demonstrate how each architectural decision mitigates specific attack vectors. Deployed in production at a major cloud provider managing network infrastructure across hundreds of datacenters, the system enforces granular access control for 20+ specialized AI agents and 60+ deterministic playbooks processing thousands of operations daily while maintaining zero unauthorized write operations over eight months of production deployment. We present empirical data on access pattern distributions, denial rates, and the effectiveness of layered authorization in preventing privilege escalation by non-deterministic actors.

</details>


### [451] [DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22555)
*Mahmood Bayeshi,Veysel Kocaman,Muhammed Ali Naqvi,Yigit Gul,David Talby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DeepLens Diagnosis Agent，一种五阶段诊断流水线，结合小模型(7B)和RAG，在DiagnosisArena基准上达到60.14% top-1准确率，比无流程时提升36个点，成本仅$0.0072/例，优于Claude和Gemini等大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM虽强但单次提示推理脆弱，诊断推理需要结构化流程而非仅知识回忆。小模型在标准医学基准上表现好(88.2%)但在不确定性诊断推理中差(23.99%)，说明需要流程约束。

Method: 五阶段流水线：(1)结构化临床信息提取 (2)约束检索(RAG) (3)受限候选生成 (4)明确证据三角验证 (5)可审计最终决策。核心是JSL Medical Small 7B v2模型。

Result: DiagnosisArena基准915例上top-1准确率60.14%，小中模型中最高。相比无流程的23.99%提升36点。成本$0.0072/例，延迟24秒，比Claude便宜35-45%且高出9.70pp，比Gemini便宜且高出9.17pp。

Conclusion: 流程约束可弥补小模型参数不足，甚至纠正前沿模型错误。结构化中间产物支持可审计、可复现、可追溯，适用于高风险医疗场景。诊断推理需要流程设计而非仅知识回忆或模型规模。

Abstract: Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

</details>


### [452] [CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22642)
*Aakash Kolekar,Sahika Genc,Shahriar Shariat,Bunyamin Sisman,Tibor Mezi,Barbara Poblete,Shree Vandana Kachroo,Calvin Chi,Parth Parmar,Ari Singer,Prayaas Jain,Cindy Barker,Benoit Dumoulin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CRAFT提出了一种两阶段后训练方法，让编码智能体在不依赖冗长prompt注入的情况下，通过微调与强化学习掌握企业级schema知识和工具使用行为，在广告分析场景下相比基准方法提升了Agent Score 9.6个百分点，同时减少9倍输入token负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有企业级编码智能体将完整的schema和工具文档注入每个prompt，导致推理开销大、schema演变更困难、多轮分析可靠性差。作者希望探索能否通过后训练让智能体内化schema知识并保持一致性，从而摆脱对prompt注入的依赖。

Method: 两阶段后训练方法：第一阶段为schema剥离的PLAN监督微调，从已验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划和可执行行为，避免prompt注入schema；第二阶段为执行形状的强化学习，优化工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性及故障恢复。训练轨迹通过三重门过滤器（执行验证、数据完整性检查、LLM推理审计）筛选。

Result: 在广告分析场景中（25个核心实体、30个智能体工作流），相比注入完整schema的基线：Agent Score提升9.6个百分点，一致性提升4.1个百分点，多轮连贯性提升4.2个百分点；输入token负担减少约9倍；schema发现循环减少最多5倍。

Conclusion: CRAFT通过后训练方法成功让编码智能体内化schema知识，显著提升性能、一致性和效率。同时指出了部署权衡、奖励塑形局限以及企业环境多轮工具使用强化学习所需的训练基础设施扩展。

Abstract: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving the consistency required for production-facing analytics. We present CRAFT, a two-stage post-training recipe for schema-grounded coding agents. First, schema-stripped PLAN supervised fine-tuning learns domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without exhaustive prompt-time schema injection. Second, execution-shaped reinforcement learning aligns the policy for tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency, and recovery from failed executions. Training trajectories are curated through a Tri-Gate filter combining execution validation, data-integrity checks, and LLM-judge reasoning audit. We evaluate CRAFT for planned rollout in advertising analytics, covering campaign performance analysis, metric drill-downs, entity-level performance analysis, and multi-turn analytical refinement. The enterprise evaluation environment incorporates beta APIs as the agent-facing tool surface and spans 25 schema-linked core entities and 30 agentic workflows. Relative to a schema-stuffed baseline, CRAFT improves composite Agent Score by +9.6 pp, consistency by +4.1 pp, and multi-turn coherence by +4.2 pp, while reducing input-token burden by approximately 9x and schema-discovery loops by up to 5x. We further report deployment tradeoffs, reward-shaping limitations, and training-infrastructure extensions required for multi-turn tool-use reinforcement learning in enterprise settings.

</details>


### [453] [MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22556)
*Dong Li,Yanchi Liu,Xujiang Zhao,Wei Cheng,Zhengzhang Chen,Xintao Wu,Zhong Chen,Chen Zhao,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MIITA是一种针对资源受限场景下小语言模型的持续学习方法，通过存储和检索修正方向原型与语义锚点，利用门控临时隐藏状态适配实现无损知识复用，无需更新主干网络或反向传播，在固定记忆预算下有效缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型在持续学习中面临参数空间有限导致的灾难性遗忘问题。现有基于记忆的方法虽能解耦知识保留与参数更新，但专为大语言模型设计的方法依赖充足存储和强上下文推理能力，不适合资源受限的小语言模型。

Method: MIITA框架：1) 将监督经验存储为紧凑的修正方向原型和语义锚点；2) 推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索；3) 通过门控临时隐藏状态适配应用检索到的方向修正，实现无损知识复用，无需主干更新、提示扩展或测试时反向传播。

Result: 在多种有监督持续学习设置下的广泛实验表明，MIITA在固定记忆预算下持续提升最终性能并有效缓解遗忘。

Conclusion: MIITA通过内存诱导的推理时适配策略，为资源受限场景下的小语言模型提供了一种轻量级、非破坏性的持续学习方案，理论分析也支持其有效性。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

</details>


### [454] [A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22682)
*Bardiya Akhbari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于描述和比较自动化研究系统的词汇表，涵盖代理、操作、通信、可见信息等八个维度，并区分了生成性品味和评估性品味两个概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化研究系统设计多样，缺乏统一的描述框架，导致设计选择难以比较和检验。作者希望通过提出标准化词汇表，将结构性问题转化为可测试的选择，并厘清"缺乏品味"这一模糊批评的具体含义。

Method: 定义一个包含8个维度的词汇表：1)代理是谁，2)可用操作，3)谁可调用操作，4)代理如何通信，5)哪些信息可见，6)如何选择下一步行动，7)运行如何开始，8)输出如何评估。同时引入轨迹记录和品味区分（生成性品味与评估性品味）。

Result: 该词汇表能够涵盖多种结构迥异的现有自动研究系统，将设计问题（如代理何时通信、能力增减、跨运行信息传递）转化为可测试的假设，并将评估器作为系统组件分离出来。

Conclusion: 该词汇表为自动化研究系统的设计与比较提供了统一框架，通过区分生成性品味和评估性品味，为改进系统提供了明确方向。

Abstract: We introduce a vocabulary for automated research systems built from one or more agents to make their design choices easier to describe and compare. The vocabulary specifies 1) who the agents are, 2) what operations are available in the system, 3) who may invoke them, 4) how agents communicate, 5) what information is visible within and across runs, 6) how the next action is chosen, 7) how a run begins, and 8) how outputs are evaluated. A trajectory records one run from the input task to the returned artifact. Because agents, operations, and initialization may be stochastic, repeated runs on the same task induce a distribution over trajectories rather than a single behavior.
  Our vocabulary turns structural design questions, such as when agents should communicate, gain or lose a capability, or carry information across runs, into testable choices. It also makes the evaluator a component of the system, since reported gains depend on how closely the proxy score matches true quality. That separation also splits the vague complaint that these systems lack taste into two failures with different solutions. Generative taste is the rate at which a system proposes novel trajectories before any score is observed, and evaluative taste is the gap between the proxy score and the quality it should match. We instantiate the vocabulary on recent autoresearch systems to illustrate that it covers designs that differ widely in structure.

</details>


### [455] [Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22561)
*Tzu-Heng Huang,Shengqi Qiu,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出程序蒸馏方法，用程序委员会替代LLM评估，实现低成本、高效率、可解释的自动化评估系统PAJAMA，在多个基准上匹配13B LLM性能，且蒸馏出的奖励模型在成本降低两个数量级情况下表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决LLM-as-a-judge方法成本高、延迟大、决策不透明的问题，寻求一种可扩展且可靠的自动化评估替代方案。

Method: 提出PAJAMA系统：将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为程序委员会（programmatic judges），这些程序直接对候选进行评分；聚合多个程序的判决形成联合裁决；引入降级机制，将低置信度案例回退到LLM处理。

Result: 在5个数据集和4个模型家族上，程序化评估器匹配了13B LLM评估器的性能；作为路由信号时，PAJAMA提升了准确率和吞吐量，推进了帕累托前沿；在RewardBench上，蒸馏出的奖励模型以两个数量级更低的API成本超越了使用专有LLM标签训练的模型。

Conclusion: 程序蒸馏是一种简单高效的替代方案，程序化评估器不仅可用于评估，还能产生廉价有效的奖励信号，为自动化评估提供了可解释、可控、低成本的新范式。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

</details>


### [456] [Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Coding Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22917)
*Shouren Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ATWZ 是一个基于文件系统的操作层，通过将每个代理视为员工并保存其工作状态到专用目录（工作站），解决了 Claude Code 代理团队在工作流中出现的状态丢失、压缩导致细节模糊、技术债务累积及提示编写负担过重等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 编码代理（如 Claude Code）在长期工作流中存在四大缺陷：代理团队状态不可恢复、压缩导致工作细节丢失、代理技术债务累积、以及需要反复编写冗长提示词。

Method: 设计 ATWZ 作为文件系统级操作层，核心思想是将每个代理视为人类员工，将重要工作状态、技能、钩子和脚本保存在名为"工作站"的专用目录中，实现状态定期备份、进程恢复、文档传递等功能。

Result: 代理团队可定期备份工作状态，压缩后仍可恢复代理知识；进程结束后可通过单条命令恢复团队；大幅减少提示词编写工作量。

Conclusion: ATWZ 通过文件系统持久化代理工作状态，有效解决了长期代理工作流中的可持续性问题，降低了技术债务和提示编写负担。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.

</details>


### [457] [SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22562)
*Ning Yang,Siqi Li,Miaoxin Shen,Yuan Zhou,Meng Zhang,Tong Li,Haijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SF-AMS框架，通过效用驱动的记忆生存机制和复合重要性评分，动态维护高价值记忆以提升LLM智能体的长上下文推理能力，在多项基准上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在处理长上下文时面临冗余和无关信息导致多步推理性能下降的瓶颈。

Method: 提出战略遗忘框架SF-AMS，核心包括：(1) 效用驱动的生存机制，根据使用冗余度和时间信号更新记忆重要性；(2) 层次化记忆结构，优先保留稳定实体一致信息；(3) 复合重要性评分，融合语义和实体层面信号提升检索鲁棒性。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上持续超越Strong baselines（LightMem、MemO、A-Mem）。最大提升：多跳推理（Qwen2.5-7B）F1+9.65；时序推理（GPT-4o-mini）F1+6.91；开放域任务F1+6.53，展示强跨骨干泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号对于可靠的长上下文推理至关重要。

Abstract: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

</details>


### [458] [Let AI Agents Translate Networks, Not Reason About Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22947)
*Hongyu Hè,Maria Apostolaki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TypoNet框架，利用LLM将网络配置自动翻译为可验证的形式化模型，代替端到端AI推理，通过求解器进行可靠的长程推理，在网络运维（可达性验证、变更影响分析、故障定位）中更快、更便宜、更可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产网络几乎不存在形式化模型，因为手工编写需要稀缺专家知识且难以随网络频繁变更持续更新。网络建模本质上是一种翻译工作（将配置、拓扑等转化为形式逻辑规则），而LLM擅长此类翻译且翻译结果可被形式化验证。

Method: 将AI限制在翻译环节（将网络工件翻译为形式逻辑规则），构建可复用的通用网络行为形式化模型，再针对特定任务（如根因分析）进行特化。实现TypoNet系统，从网络工件自动构建并验证符号模型。

Result: TypoNet在回答运维问题（可达性验证、变更影响分析）上比LLM更快、更廉价、更可靠；作为AI Agent的工具，以更低成本提升故障定位能力。

Conclusion: 主张AI应构建可验证的网络模型，并依赖求解器进行可靠的长程推理，而非让AI代理端到端自主决策。

Abstract: A formal model enables verifying reachability, localizing an outage, or anticipating the blast radius of a change. Yet, virtually no production network has one, since writing a model by hand demands rare expertise and is hard to keep current as the network changes frequently. At its core, network modeling is a typographical exercise: it translates network artifacts (e.g., configurations, topology, and routing state) into rules in formal logic. Translation of this kind is what large language models (LLMs) nowadays do well. Unlike free-form AI reasoning, such translation can be formally verified.
  Once modeling is no longer the bottleneck, trusting AI to reason over large, complex networks no longer makes sense. Our position therefore cuts against the prevailing race to put autonomous AI agents in charge end-to-end. We instead confine AI to translation and rely on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning, building a reusable formal model of general network behavior that can then be specialized to specific tasks, e.g., root-cause analysis (RCA). We build TypoNet that constructs and validates a symbolic model of an emulated production-scale WAN from the network's own artifacts. Our preliminary evaluation shows TypoNet helps in two ways. On its own, TypoNet answers operational questions (e.g., reachability verification and change-impact analysis) faster, more cheaply, and more reliably than an LLM. As a tool for an AI agent, TypoNet boosts fault localization at lower cost. The result makes the case for AI that builds verifiable network models and relies on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning.

</details>


### [459] [Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22563)
*Sagar Chethan Kumar,Rohith Kanathur,Dhaval Patel,Kaoutar El Maghraoui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对工业智能体基准测试场景不足的问题，在AssetOpsBench基础上新增智能电网变压器资产类别和四种IEC诊断工具，并提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道实现合成场景的自动生成，通过多重优化将生成50个场景的耗时减少8倍，同时保持场景质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业智能体基准（如AssetOpsBench）依赖手动编写场景，覆盖资产类别有限，缺乏可扩展性，亟需自动化、标准化且高效的场景生成方法。

Method: 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道，包含：证据驱动的资产画像构建、覆盖感知的场景预算分配、混合验证-修复循环（涵盖模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐和去重），并通过二级缓存、并行生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤提升可扩展性。

Result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成中，优化后的管道将50个场景的端到端运行时间减少8倍，综合质量分数为74.2±1.9，与未优化基线的73.8±3.0相当。

Conclusion: 基于标准的合成场景生成能够高效扩展工业智能体基准，在显著提升效率的同时不牺牲场景质量。

Abstract: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

</details>


### [460] [Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22564)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多臂老虎机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，将每个候选特征图视为臂，通过临时遮蔽并评估损失变化来生成安全移除奖励，在固定预算后永久移除Top-k特征图及对应参数。UCB1和Thompson Sampling在多个数据集上表现优异，接近未剪枝模型精度，显著优于贪心和基于幅度的剪枝方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卷积神经网络中存在冗余特征图，导致存储和推理成本增加，需要一种结构化的剪枝方法在移除特征图的同时最小化精度损失。

Method: 将每个候选特征图视为老虎机的一个臂，每次临时遮蔽一个特征图并在小批量数据上评估损失变化，将损失变化转换为安全移除奖励；经过固定预算后根据学习到的分数排序，永久移除Top-k特征图及其对应的滤波器、偏置和下一层输入通道核。使用UCB1和Thompson Sampling作为探索-利用策略。

Result: UCB1和Thompson Sampling在LeNet/MNIST以及CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、CUB-200-2011、Oxford Flowers 102等数据集上均能保持接近未剪枝模型的精度，同时有效减少特征图和卷积计算量。Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1平均排名最高，Thompson Sampling次之，两者显著优于贪心和幅度剪枝，与原始模型统计上可比。

Conclusion: 基于多臂老虎机的剪枝方法能有效识别冗余特征图，在保持精度的前提下实现结构化剪枝，UCB1是最优策略，为模型压缩提供了高效且损失感知的新思路。

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.

</details>


### [461] [Separating Capability from Permission: A Governance Framework for Agentic AI Autonomy Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23438)
*Haining Zheng,Qian Dong,Rodolfo K. Depena,Jonathan D. Bhatia,Feng Xiao,Peng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将AI代理的"许可自主等级"(AAL)与"能力自主等级"(ACL)分离的治理框架，通过风险感知决策流程为高风险高能力系统设定更低授权水平，并在企业数据工程代理中验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于AI自主性的讨论混淆了技术能力与授权许可，缺乏清晰的治理框架来区分AI系统"能做什么"和"被允许做什么"，需要一套结构化的方法来指导自主决策的权限分配。

Method: 提出AAL与ACL分离的治理框架，定义从反应式执行到授权运营的五级自主层级，设计风险感知决策流程，通过控制性、可逆性和问责性三个维度分析自主性变化。

Result: 在企业数据工程代理中，一个高能力系统被有意约束到较低的许可自主等级，基于风险、可逆性和组织准备度实现了安全部署。

Conclusion: 通过区分授权与能力，该框架为Agentic AI系统的设计、部署和治理提供了实用指南，有助于在技术能力与安全可控之间取得平衡。

Abstract: As AI systems increasingly exhibit agentic behavior, discussions of autonomy often conflate what systems are technically capable of doing with what they should be permitted to do in practice. This paper introduces a governance framework that explicitly separates Allowed Autonomy Levels (AAL), which define the degree of autonomy an AI agent is authorized to exercise given risk, oversight, and accountability considerations, from Autonomous Capability Levels (ACL), which characterize an agent's inherent technical abilities. We present a structured set of autonomy levels spanning reactive execution, decision support, supervised action, goal-directed autonomy, and delegated operational authority, and describe how control, reversibility, and accountability change as autonomy increases. To operationalize this framework, we propose a risk-aware decision process for assigning allowed autonomy, analyze how risk and accountability evolve across autonomy levels, and demonstrate its application through a deployed enterprise data engineering agent, illustrating how a system assessed at a high capability level can be deliberately constrained to a lower allowed autonomy based on risk, reversibility, and organizational readiness. By distinguishing authorization from capability, this work provides practical guidance for the design, deployment, and governance of Agentic AI systems.

</details>


### [462] [DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22565)
*Qingzhong Li,Hui Ma,Yajun Zhang,Qingchang Ma,Zhou Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DSTFView，一种面向云边协同环境的双输入时空频多视角工作负载预测框架，通过联合建模临近与周期依赖、提取时空频特征及自适应融合机制，在CPU和TP数据集上优于多个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘平台需支持延迟敏感、高并发及高可靠应用，但现有方法难以在云边协同环境中平衡多维特征建模与预测效率。

Method: 提出DSTFView框架：1) 双输入结构联合建模临近依赖与周期依赖；2) 提取空间、时间、频域多视角依赖；3) 设计自适应融合机制调整各视角贡献以捕捉突变。

Result: 在CPU和TP数据集上，DSTFView在不同预测步长和评估指标下均一致优于代表性基线方法。

Conclusion: DSTFView有效解决了云边协同环境下工作负载预测中多维特征建模与预测效率的平衡问题，验证了多视角融合及自适应机制的有效性。

Abstract: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

</details>


### [463] [MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22566)
*Zeyu Zhang,Ziqing Wang,Kaize Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedLoCoMo是一个用于评估LLM在多次入院医疗对话中进行患者特异性临床推理的长上下文记忆基准，包含100条患者时间线，平均每条对话1,669.8轮次、29.7次会话、74,512.2个token。实验发现跨入院推理比单次入院证据使用困难得多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗QA基准主要测试短上下文知识或单文档推理，缺乏评估LLM在纵向患者病史中进行使用、连接和弃权推理的能力。

Method: 从MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note构建入院级临床包，合成医患对话，生成单次入院、跨入院和对抗性不可回答三种类型的证据链接QA。

Result: 跨入院推理始终比局部证据使用更难，即使模型拥有长上下文窗口或使用外部记忆/检索方法也难以解决。

Conclusion: MedLoCoMo揭示了现有LLM在纵向临床推理上的显著短板，为医疗长上下文理解提供了重要评估基准。

Abstract: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings. The benchmark contains 100 patient timelines averaging 1,669.8 turns, 29.7 sessions, and 74,512.2 tokens per conversation. Across the evaluated baselines, cross-admission reasoning is consistently harder than localized evidence use, even when models have long context windows or use external memory or retrieval methods. The code and MedLoCoMo benchmark release is available at https://github.com/leozzy13/MedLoCoMo for use and reproducibility.

</details>


### [464] [Grading the Narrators: An Isnad-Rijal Framework for Claim-Level Provenance in Multi-Agent Knowledge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24117)
*Ali Zahid Raja*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将古典伊斯兰圣训学（Hadith science）的完整方法论——传述链（isnad）、人物评定（rijal）、最弱链评估、多链交叉印证、内容批评（matn）——系统迁移至现代多智能体知识系统，设计了包含分级传输者可靠性、转换类型聚合、内容/链路解耦评判的运作框架，并在20000条物理教科书声明上进行了评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识溯源系统只记录了"发生了什么"（执行轨迹、工具调用、证据链接），但缺乏一个将分级、按领域划分的传输者可靠性附加到声明级传输链的运作框架，且未涵盖完整性语义、转换类型聚合、内容与链路的解耦评判以及服务/审查/隔离路由机制。

Method: 1) 建立圣训学概念到多智能体管线的形式化映射；2) 设计实现声明链与分级叙述者注册表的关系型模式；3) 构建结合链路评级与内容批评的决策矩阵；4) 在20000条来自真实物理教科书的声明上评估最弱链隔离、独立链交叉印证、等级恢复循环等机制。

Result: 最弱链隔离和独立链交叉印证被验证有效；等级恢复循环部分失败（遗漏了最高错误率叙述者）；两项分析结果不明确，包括框架未能达成与参考内容批评者的匹配覆盖率比较。

Conclusion: 圣训学方法论可有效迁移至AI知识系统设计，但存在局限性（如等级恢复循环的部分失效），论文对证据尚不支持的部分保持了高度透明。

Abstract: Modern multi-agent knowledge systems increasingly accumulate knowledge through chains of autonomous transformations rather than direct retrieval. Existing provenance work records what happened - execution traces, tool calls, evidence links - and source-reliability estimation is long established (truth discovery, reputation systems). What is missing is an operational framework that attaches graded, per-domain transmitter reliability to claim-level transmission chains, with completeness semantics, transformation-typed aggregation, decoupled content criticism, and serve/review/quarantine routing.
  Classical Islamic hadith science confronted a structurally similar problem: deciding whether knowledge transmitted through chains of human narrators should be accepted. Over centuries it developed a rigorous methodology - isnad (a complete transmission chain attached to every claim), rijal (systematic grading of each narrator's integrity and precision), weakest-link chain evaluation, corroboration through independent chains, and matn criticism (content evaluated independently of chain quality). This paper transfers that methodology to AI system design.
  We contribute a formal mapping from hadith-science concepts to multi-agent pipelines, a relational schema implementing claim chains and a graded narrator registry, a decision matrix combining chain grade with content criticism, and an evaluation on 20,000 claims from real physics textbooks. The evaluation validates weakest-link quarantine and independent-chain corroboration; reports a partial failure of the grade-recovery loop, which missed the highest-fault narrator; and reports two analyses as inconclusive, including a matched-coverage comparison the framework could not reach with the reference content critic. The paper is explicit throughout about which claims the evidence does and does not yet support.

</details>


### [465] [Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22568)
*Ruiyi Tao,Xiaolong Tu,Haoxin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过智能手机上的真实功耗测量，实证研究了提示词措辞对设备端大语言模型能量消耗的影响，发现指令性关键词和指令结构会显著影响解码长度和总能耗，表明提示工程可作为提升能效的轻量级手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在移动和嵌入式设备上部署时面临能耗瓶颈，而现有工作主要关注模型压缩和运行时加速，忽视了提示词设计对能效的影响，因此本文填补了这一研究空白。

Method: 在智能手机上对设备端LLM进行真实功耗测量，系统性地改变提示词中的动词和指令结构等语言特征，量化它们与解码长度、总能耗之间的关系。

Result: 不同动词和任务之间观察到一致的能耗差异，提示词的措辞选择会显著影响模型的解码长度和总能量消耗。

Conclusion: 提示工程可作为提升设备端LLM能效的轻量级杠杆，无需修改模型或硬件即可实现节能效果。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile and embedded devices to improve privacy and reduce network latency. Yet on-device inference faces a fundamental constraint: high energy consumption on battery-powered, resource-limited hardware. While model compression and runtime acceleration have been widely studied, the effect of \emph{prompt design} on energy efficiency remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study of the relationship between prompt wording and energy consumption for on-device LLMs. Using real power measurements collected on a smartphone, we quantify how linguistic features, particularly imperative keywords and instruction structure, affect decoding length and total energy. Our results show consistent energy differences across verbs and tasks, indicating that prompt engineering is a lightweight lever for improving energy efficiency.

</details>


### [466] [Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.22569)
*Yifei Ge,Weisong Sun,Jinkun Xiao,Yuchen Chen,Yebo Feng,Peizhuo Lv,Xia Feng,Chunrong Fang,Zhihong Zhao,Zhenyu Chen,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于执行迹的对抗性测试框架，通过将恶意操作伪装成常规软件工程任务（如单元测试、回归测试），检测编码智能体在执行层的安全边界。实验表明，该方法能显著增加智能体执行不安全操作的成功率（代码载体达73.61%，文本载体达53.93%），揭示当前编码智能体在系统运维中存在严重安全隐患。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全测试过于关注智能体的语言输出，忽视了其对环境的实际操作（如修改系统脚本、持久化后门）。因此需要一种基于执行层证据的测试方法，评估智能体在真实系统操作中的安全性。
